items.title: The Vanishing Beauty
items.description: Yu Meng, an only child from Jiangsu Zhejiang Shanghai and a popular internet blogger, is admired as a woman with a perfect life. On her fifth wedding anniversary, the bubble of her seemingly flawless happiness shatters. Her model husband is no longer so perfect, and her marriage begins to crack, while she also faces the threat of being financially exploited. With the support of her friends, Yu Meng reexamines her life and fights to take back control.

items.title: 100 Days of Deception
items.description: Hoping for freedom, Gyeongseong's top pickpocket infiltrates the Japanese colonial government to steal secrets — only to fall for her target's son.

items.title: Doctor X: Mafia in White
items.description: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

items.title: The Masked Lover
items.description: A bandit leader's deputy and an opera troupe orphan seeking revenge become unlikely allies when they uncover a plot to trade a family treasure for opium and join forces to seize it.

items.title: Fatal Proximity to Him
items.description: A time-traveling ballerina and a troubled student are trapped in a deadly cycle of love and death, forcing them to find the killer before fate repeats itself.

items.title: Bloodhounds Season 2
items.description: Faced with ruthless foes with a violent thirst, two young boxers band together — risking life and limb to bring justice and protect their loved ones.

items.title: Live Forever
items.description: Ning Changyue and Song Yiqiu share a deep, timeless connection that spans three thousand years. In the present day, their journey to understand love, belonging, and eternity is complicated by the resurfacing of a long-buried past and unresolved fates. Facing the echoes of history and the trials of the modern world, they must make pivotal choices that define their love and ultimate home.

items.title: Fool in Love
items.description: A powerful heir uses business to pursue an aristocrat, only to become hopelessly entangled in a romantic trap of his own making.

items.title: Carrie (2026)
items.description: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie White is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social-media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

items.title: Kiseki Miracle Season
items.description: When four boys meet on a Tokyo trip, their lives quietly intertwine—leading to love, growth, and a winter that might bring them back together.

items.title: Season of Love in Shimane (2025)
items.description: When four boys meet on a Tokyo trip, their lives quietly intertwine—leading to love, growth, and a winter that might bring them back together.

items.title: The Journey to Killing You Season 2
items.description: Ordered to guard—and secretly kill—his underboss, a vengeful yakuza begins to fall for the very man he swore to destroy.

items.title: Twisted Tie
items.description: Kang Dojin is a ruthless, perfectionist team leader at a VVIP spatial design agency, and Lee Sunwoo is a rookie who blindly admires him. While secretly nurturing a subtle mutual attraction, their relationship is instantly flipped upside down on a rainy night shift when Sunwoo, losing his mind to Dojin's calculated provocation, crosses the line. Afterward, Dojin suggests a secret, in-office 'hands-on tutoring' session to the confused Sunwoo, placing him firmly under his control. However, Baek Yigeon, a sly manager from a partner company, steps between them and starts provoking Sunwoo. Dojin, who once sought to control everything with pure logic, is gradually consumed by uncontrollable jealousy and possessiveness until his perfect facade completely breaks down.

items.title: The WONDERfools
items.description: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

items.title: Boy, with Caution
items.description: A disgraced teacher finds comfort in an anonymous chat partner, unaware the troubled student behind the messages is growing closer to him.

items.title: The Love Hypothesis
items.description: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

items.title: Irreplaceable (2026)
items.description: After witnessing her mother's suicide following a divorce, Xu Chi defies her tragic fate by rising from an ordinary graduate to a sharp-witted top consultant. Drawn into the covert revenge scheme of seasoned partner Ye Xinzhi, who mentors her while navigating their growing mutual attraction, the duo confronts a crossroads when professional upheavals collide with their evolving bond.

items.title: Shadow Punisher
items.description: Lord Qingyang's son, Li Si, devised a plan to infiltrate the Imperial Detective Division to uncover the truth behind the death of the Fourth Prince. There, he met and joined forces with Bai Zhenzhu, the finest female forensic expert in the land; and Meng Rui, a ghost-catcher renowned for his martial prowess but burdened with a deep-seated vendetta. Together, they formed the Divine Detectives. With seamless teamwork and unwavering determination, this trio ventured through perilous challenges, solving eight enigmatic and bizarre cases.

items.title: Between Steps
items.description: Minjae, a former swimmer, lost a leg to illness. Now a PhD student, he's built a quiet, controlled life, until Yujin, a master's student starting over after losing her way, throws it off balance. In a robotics lab, their romance turns fiery, bittersweet, and tender.

items.title: The D Dorm
items.description: When Dobby declares his intent to sell the D Dorm, he ends up on a mission to track down the first love of the spirit A Kong in exchange for the right. All the while, he has to deal with the residents trying all sorts of methods to prevent the sale.

items.title: Dive into You
items.description: An actress and her twin brother slip through time – and swap bodies – to save their friend's life.

items.title: Plastic Beauty
items.description: When a gifted ER surgeon is thrust into cosmetic medicine, her clash with a celebrity doctor exposes the greed and desire beneath the glamour.

items.title: My Drama Missy
items.description: When script meets reality, a theater understudy shares a starlet's life—days as a nobody, nights dodging a playboy's advances. He sees through her act but plays along. As fiction spirals out of control, their scripted romance proves real chemistry beats perfect roles.

items.title: My Queen, My Rules
items.description: An aloof CEO, Cen Sen, and a proud heiress, Ji Mingshu, are bound by a marriage of convenience. What begins as mutual suspicion and manipulation gradually transforms into a profound love as they fight against fate and risk everything to save each other.

items.title: A Prophet (2026)
items.description: After his family is wiped out by the Tianxiang Sect, Shangguan Chengming goes undercover to take revenge. With the help of Jiang Feiyan, they use a series of scams to expose corruption and fight for justice.

items.title: Spring of the Blade
items.description: After losing her mother as a child, Xie Qingyuan returns years later to uncover the truth and seek justice. Reuniting with Shen Run, once a fallen youth and now a righteous court official, they join forces to expose corruption and right past wrongs. Through shared dangers and unwavering support, they grow closer, devoting their lives to protecting each other and their people.

items.title: Our Yesterday's Escape
items.description:
The final installment of the University Series, the story centers on Kierra, an architecture student who came from an abusive relationship, and Shan, the playboy law student she has a one-night stand with. Can this one casual night lead to a love that can heal their traumas?

(Source: Viva One)
~~ Adapted from the sixth web novel "Our Yesterday's Escape" in the novel series "University Series" by Gwy Saludes.

items.title: Oops! Mysterious Sounds
items.description: Forced into a fake relationship, college rivals Phodduang and Jinna team up to solve an actor's murder using a supernatural earpiece that guides them.

items.title: Friendly Rivalry
items.description: A high-teen mystery thriller about a close relationship between teenage girls in a harsher survival competition than entrance examinations.

items.title: Fireworks of My Heart
items.description: Fire chief Song Yan and emergency doctor Xu Qin were separated by family opposition when they were younger. Now ten years later, they meet again due to their professions. After experiencing life and death together, they manage to find their way back, working together and encouraging each other. They acknowledge each other's individual growth after years apart, but will they be able to overcome the obstacles in their path this time to stay together?

items.title: Love Against Time
items.description: A group of young people who survived life-threatening health struggles moves into a house together to find true love. Having faced life's fragility firsthand, they look past the superficial to build deep, intense, and meaningful connections—without wasting a single second.

items.title: Against the Current
items.description: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

items.title: Love Destiny
items.description: When a modern surgeon's soul is cast into a hated 17th-century troublemaker, he uses advanced medicine to save lives and win over his fierce rival.

items.title: Knot
items.description: A young man’s life changes forever when a powerful Alpha marks him, binding their fates together in an inescapable bond.

items.title: Cinderella at 2AM
items.description: Ha Yoon-seo has worked hard her whole life: after raising her younger brother alone, she is now a marketing manager at a credit card company. Her life takes a dramatic turn when she discovers that her boyfriend, Seo Ju-won, is the heir to the family that owns the company! Upon learning of their relationship, Ju-won's mother offers Yoon-seo money to break up with him, and Yoon-seo accepts. However, Ju-won is determined to win her back and will stop at nothing to reclaim her heart. Can Yoon-seo and Ju-won overcome obstacles and find their fairytale ending, or will reality tear them apart?

items.title: Sword God 2026
items.description: Left crippled and betrayed after his sect is destroyed, a fallen cultivator rebuilds his power and rises to challenge his enemies, his fate, and the heavens themselves.

items.title: Popular Serizawa Acts Weird Around Me
items.description: A lonely teen secretly writes a romance novel based on his popular classmate, only for the boy to read it and intensely pursue him in real life.

items.title: Something in the Rain
items.description: Explore the relationship of two people as they go from being “just acquaintances” to “a genuine couple” — Yoon Jin Ah, a coffee shop  supervisor in her 30s, and Seo Joon Hee, a designer at a video game company who has just returned from working abroad.

items.title: Blossom Through the Cloud
items.description: Once a flight attendant, Ruan Sixian pursues her piloting dream through flight school, later clashing and reconciling with aviation executive Fu Mingyu in a high-stakes race for industry innovation and mutual professional redemption.

items.title: Love Song in Winter
items.description: Since the anesthesiologist Lu Yan “runs into” her dead college friend Deng Man during a night shift, strange things around her occur successively. As the investigation proceeds, the detective Jiang Chengyi, Lu Yan’s ex-boyfriend from many years ago, is embroiled in it, and the long-hidden truth of eight years is gradually revealed.

items.title: The First Frost
items.description: Wen Yifan, by chance, ends up living with her high school classmate Sang Yan, whom she once rejected. They keep their distance until Wen Yifan learns from Sang Yan that she sleepwalks, intertwining their lives once more.

items.title: Love Designer
items.description: A fashion designer and an e-commerce executive are brought together by a lawsuit and forced to collaborate. Despite their differences, they gradually fall in love while pursuing personal growth and success in their careers.

items.title: The Outlaw
items.description: After being abducted by human traffickers and falsely imprisoned while searching for his fiancée, Zhou Yan assumes the identity of an underworld boss and joins forces with undercover police to dismantle the criminal network responsible.

items.title: Azure Spring
items.description: Two people stuck in their lives become haenyeo divers, finding healing and new meaning in the sea as they confront their pasts and fears together.

items.title: Remnants of Gold
items.description: Three hundred thousand taels of gold suddenly surface in the vast desert, where rumor has it that all who seek the treasure are doomed to become vengeful spirits. An officer of the Imperial Guard sent to investigate descends into madness on his very first day. A loyal and courageous deputy envoy who has ventured too far to turn back finds himself torn between desire and honor. After her entire family is slaughtered, a woman immune to all poisons returns to the vast desert, deliberately making herself the prize every faction is determined to seize as she sets out for revenge. Beneath the vast desert's sweeping sands lie an insatiable greed for gold and a carefully laid trap designed to lure her into the deadly game. From a relay station and an armed escort agency to a general's residence, a band of martial heroes becomes entangled in a deadly struggle across the vast and desolate frontier, bringing the spirit and ideals of Eastern wuxia to life in a new light.

items.title: As Beautiful As You
items.description: Ji Xing, a technical talent who works diligently in a technology company, resigned resolutely in order to realize her dream and embarked on the road of entrepreneurship. The team formed by Ji Xing and her younger brother was in jeopardy at the beginning of the business. Just when there was no hope, Ji Xing won the support of Han Ting, President of Dongyang Technology, with his unique insights. With Han Ting's investment, the startup Xingchen is finally on the right track. But Ji Xing "lost" her first boyfriend who she had been in love with for seven years. The difficulties of starting a business and the pain of breaking up with her love almost destroyed her. Fortunately, she has the close protection of the sister group.

items.title: The Early Spring
items.description: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

items.title: In My Prime
items.description: In a small 1980s town, two families face an unexpected child swap between Qi Shi, a courageous girl with albinism, and Cao Xin, a disciplined boy seen as perfect. As they navigate identity, family, and love, both children and parents confront personal and societal challenges. Together, they struggle through hardships to find happiness and belonging in a changing world.

items.title: Khom Khlang
items.description: Bulan, a woman with a mysterious aura, crosses paths with Peem, a police officer desperate to solve a case for which the law offers no answers. Recommended as the only one capable of helping her, Bulan awakens in Peem doubts, attraction, and an unexpected bond that will challenge her beliefs and her understanding of justice.

items.title: Prelude of the White Snake
items.description: After losing an important memory before ascending to immortality, Bai Suzhen descends to the mortal world with Xiao Qing to find Xu Xian and repay a past kindness. Along the way, they become entangled with demon hunter Xu Xian and Fa Hai, setting the four on a fateful journey.

items.title: No. 9 Hunter
items.description: After a mystical reversal turns the divine stone spirit Shangguan Ziyan into a man, he joins the disciplined Daoist Yuan Chu in the Yuan Zhen Sect. Appointed as demon hunters, the two embark on a mission to seal monsters and restore the heavens—only to uncover each other’s hidden secrets along the way.

items.title: City Rong
items.description: After his family is massacred, Lian Ye teams up with police official Li Mingyuan and dance hall owner Chen Dieyi to investigate the tragedy. Their investigation exposes a Japanese espionage conspiracy threatening the city, forcing them to fight the invaders and defend their homeland.

items.title: Love Is Better the Second Time Around 2
items.description: Journalist Akihiro reunites with Takashi, his high school love, now a professor. Old emotions resurface as they navigate between professionalism and the past.

items.title: Duty First, Kiss Later
items.description: An old-school detective and his cold, ambitious partner find their growing attraction complicating life inside a rural police station.

items.title: A Love Other Than Yours
items.description: After 10 years together, Namgung Ho and film director Lee Mi-do find their once-passionate relationship settling into quiet trust. When Mi-do develops feelings for another man during a difficult period in her career, the couple must decide whether to move forward with marriage or go their separate ways.

items.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
items.description: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

items.title: Your Third
items.description: A secretary sent to retrieve his boss’s runaway brother falls for the heartbroken man he’s meant to bring home.

items.title: Fairway of Love
items.description: "Fairway of Love" revolves around the competitive and romance-filled world of professional golf. The story follows a young, wealthy heiress to a major golf empire whose life takes an unexpected turn when she crosses paths with an enigmatic female golfer on the green.After a literal and figurative clash during a tournament, an intense spark ignites between them. As they navigate the high-stakes pressure of the sport, family expectations, and personal rivalries, they must decide if they are willing to risk everything for a chance at true love.

items.title: LOVEx3
items.description: Six students navigate secret crushes, old promises, and unexpected heartbreaks when forced to enroll in a mandatory school curriculum about love.

items.title: Match Point
items.description: When rival shop owners' sons Sun and Bay are forced to play tennis doubles, hiding their secret team gets harder as real romance begins to bloom.

items.title: The Love You Give Me
items.description: Years after a painful breakup caused by illness and misunderstanding, former lovers Min Hui and Xin Qi reunite in the business world, only for a paternity test to reveal that Min Hui’s son may be Xin Qi’s — forcing them to navigate past wounds, parenthood, and the possibility of rekindled love.

items.title: The Missing Piece
items.description: After an accident leaves Shen Mo with amnesia, he mistakes Ji Mingxuan, the man who saved him, for his lover. But when Shen Mo regains his memories, the six months they spent loving each other become completely erased. Desperate to keep Shen Mo by his side, Ji Mingxuan proposes a three-year “contract lover” arrangement. When two people are already in love, can a contract still keep their hearts in check?⠀

items.title: Third Person
items.description: Chris, a young woman suffering from amnesia, is recovering and living with her loving partner, Nadia, after an accident four years ago. Everything seems to be going well, but then the arrival of a strange woman named Sun begins to shake Chris's beliefs.

items.title: Mr. Fanboy
items.description: Cast in a BL drama with his idol, devoted fanboy Wan finds his heart pulled in a shocking new direction by the idol's protective partner, Third.

items.title: Juliet & Juliet
items.description: When the heirs of two rival families turn out to be each other's first love, will the ending be love... or tragedy?

items.title: GELBOYS Season 2
items.description: After falling for a gel-nail enthusiast, Fou4Mod gets caught in a messy love triangle when he tries to make his crush jealous.

items.title: Yesterday
items.description: To reclaim his legacy, a betrayed heir teams up with an old ally to battle a ruthless half-brother now ruling a massive business empire.

items.title: Flex x Cop Season 2
items.description: A chaebol cop joins forces with a gritty detective to take down criminals with a touch of wealth and a whole lot of wit.

items.title: A Bona Fide Killer
items.description: A contract killer for a covert organization returns after a three-year maternity leave. Her journalist husband grows increasingly suspicious and aims to uncover her secret life.

items.title: You Maniac
items.description: When a carefree playboy meets the one man who refuses to fall for his charm, his competitive ego turns into an obsession he can't resist.

items.title: Police in Love
items.description: Fate plays its tricks when it throws an unlucky soul into a search for a companion. "Can you Marry me? Just six months and we'll divorce."

items.title: The Last Oath
items.description: Immune to a deadly zombie virus, a student forms a forbidden bond with the agent sent to hunt him as they battle corrupt pharmaceutical giants.

items.title: How Do We Relationship?
items.description: College student Miwa Inuzuka has always longed for romance, yet she has never had a relationship that truly worked out. After starting university, she meets the bright and outgoing Saeko Sawatari and despite their completely opposite personalities, the two unexpectedly discover that they both like women. Can two girls who are both bad at love find their own happiness?

items.title: Hold on, Harutora-kun
items.description: To survive his boys' dorm, guarded Sui hides behind indifference. But a warm, honest new roommate threatens to break down the walls around his heart.

items.title: The Prisoner of Beauty
items.description: Xiao Qiao, a clever girl from the Qiao family, marries Wei Shao, the brave and kind master of the Wei family. Despite initial wariness due to ancestral grievances, Xiao Qiao and Wei Shao navigate their relationship with humor and determination. As they face challenges together, they come to appreciate each other's qualities through their warm daily life, intertwined with family and national affairs, and work to restore peace and resolve conflicts.

items.title: WEIRDO-101
items.description: A lazy judo athlete's life is turned upside down when a socially awkward astronomy genius saves him from trouble and openly pursues him.

items.title: Class Crush Crisis
items.description: After transferring to a top high school, aspiring rock star Leerit vows to avoid romance — but quickly changes his tune when he meets his new roommate.

items.title: Pls Love (2026)
items.description: Panapsorn has spent years surviving the glittering, merciless world of nightlife entertainment, remaining soft-spoken, selfless, and carrying wounds she learned to hide behind flawless smiles. Phakinee, on the other hand, has never had to hide anything. Beautiful, wealthy, and razor-sharp, she moves through life untouched by the things that break ordinary people, until she meets Panapsorn, whose quiet strength unsettles her in ways she cannot explain away. An unexpected encounter becomes a pull neither woman can escape. But in a world ruled by power, secrets, and the ghosts of what came before, choosing each other is an act of courage. A fierce, aching, modern sapphic romance about two women, one learning she deserves love and one discovering she can feel it, as they fight for a connection neither of them saw coming.

items.title: Make It Right 2026
items.description: After his first love falls apart, a student grows closer to a quiet classmate as he and his friends face the highs and lows of young love.

items.title: Ash
items.description: An undercover cop and a secretive CEO spark a dangerous romance amid a brutal crime war, realizing the only person they can trust is each other.

items.title: Connecting to You
items.description: A man who sees emotional bonds as colored threads finally finds his first connection with a cop, solving crimes as their bond turns to true love.

items.title: Don't Be Too Emotional
items.description: A football player befriends a mysterious wish-granter whose dangerous gifts hide secrets that draw them closer together.

items.title: Kiss or Kill
items.description: Reunited undercover in a dangerous syndicate, a mercenary and his former ally struggle to resist a forbidden passion while fighting for survival.

items.title: Dating Alys Perez
items.description: Years after moving to the US, Alys returns home as a successful pastry chef while building a life with Tripp. But seeing Drake again revives old feelings and unresolved heartbreak, pulling the three into an emotional journey of love, sacrifice, and second chances.

items.title: Love U Lots
items.description: Heartbroken Estong meets the mysterious Ysa, who has Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID), and learns that love comes with not one twist, but lots of it.

items.title: OK! Let's Get Divorced
items.description: A couple, who run a wedding dress shop together, decide to undergo a real divorce experience to end their exhausted marriage.

items.title: Summertime
items.description: Yeo Eun Ho and Cha Do Hyeon have been friends all their lives. After 19 years, Eun Ho seems to have a good grasp on Do Hyeon, even knowing that his “perfect” image at school is a facade. But what Eun Ho is absolutely oblivious to is the fact that Do Hyeon has had an obsessive crush on him for years. Though Do Hyeon has been able to keep it a secret in order to slowly ease his way into Eun Ho’s heart, the sudden arrival of a new student named Kwon Yi Hyeon throws a wrench into his plans. What will Do Hyeon do to keep Eun Ho by his side? And will Eun Ho ever realize his best friend’s feelings for him?

items.title: Unlucky Bae
items.description: After a drunken ritual goes wrong, Rin accidentally curses an innocent business student. To fix the mess, he stays close — only to fall in love.

items.title: Not Yours
items.description: A young man moves in with his wealthy creditor as a "sugar baby" to pay off his bankrupt father's debts, but their contractual arrangement gets complicated when a celebrity idol enters the picture.

items.title: The Ordinary Jackpot
items.description: An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.

items.title: Be My Player Two
items.description: To win a gaming championship, a famous streamer teams up with his biggest rival, only to risk it all when real feelings ignite.

items.title: Till I See You
items.description:
Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly "see" each other, they have already fallen in love.

But just as Feiyu is about to regain his sight, a devastating secret comes to light, forcing Song Yi to disappear without a word. Five years later, fate brings them together again. Can their unforgettable love finally be made whole?

items.title: Moonshadow
items.description:
After a painful breakup, Jan, the owner of a cozy bar, shuts her heart off from love and focuses solely on surviving in the shadows of her past. Everything changes when Key, a bold young singer, steps into her world after a one-night encounter openly declaring she wants to be Jan's sugar baby.

What begins as a purely physical arrangement morphs into something deeper as Key's warmth begins to melt Jan's icy walls. Just as their feelings become undeniable, Jan's ex unexpectedly returns, testing the fragile bond forming between them.

items.title: NOUR
items.description: When bizarre fires expose a multi-generational curse, two police officers uncover buried secrets while love and corruption threaten to consume them.

items.title: Mr.Kill
items.description: A manga artist and a determined police officer investigate murders inspired by an underground comic, uncovering a shared tragedy that links their pasts.

items.title: My Bias, My Boss
items.description: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

items.title: The Scandal
items.description: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.

items.title: Road Home
items.description: Lu Yanchen and Gui Xiao were each other's first love but separated after graduation. Years later, they meet again and realize that the sparks are still between them.

items.title: The Affair Was Just The Beginning
items.description: A successful entrepreneur with a seemingly perfect life sees everything fall apart after discovering her husband covering up a murder allegedly committed by their daughter. As the family scrambles to hide the truth, an anonymous blackmailer claims to have recorded everything, pulling them into a dangerous web of lies, secrets, and betrayal.

items.title: Someone, Someday
items.description: When the CEO of a dating app unknowingly befriends someone out for revenge, old wounds resurface—threatening her company, family, friendships, love life, and even her dream of finding “someone, someday.”

items.title: Good Boy
items.description: Olympic medalists join the police force through a special recruitment program, trading medals for badges as they tackle violent crimes and injustices with their athletic skills.

items.title: Mousetrap
items.description: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

items.title: Queen Mantis
items.description: Cha Su-yeol, a police officer who has long despised his mother, the notorious 'Mantis' serial killer, must reluctantly turn to her for help when a copycat killer emerges.

items.title: Love on the Menu
items.description: Some sacrificed love for the sake of family. Others walked away from their families to protect the ones they loved. And some, believing they were acting out of love, only left deeper wounds behind. Years of misunderstanding and conflict have driven them apart, but an unexpected bond and reunion bring them face-to-face once again. As lost love, tangled family ties, and the true feelings they have long kept hidden begin to surface, even the coldest hearts slowly begin to heal. Through love, forgiveness, and the courage to understand one another, they discover what it truly means to be a family. Can the scattered pieces of a family finally find their way back to one warm table?

items.title: Your Sky: Hare Nochi Koi
items.description: To dodge an aggressive upperclassman, Hinata enters a fake relationship with Sora, a cold senior. Can this chaotic lie blossom into something real?

items.title: In Love Forever
items.description:
After a bitter divorce caused by family pressure and emotional manipulation, successful lawyer Runchlaphat and outspoken Gen-Z heiress Peeracha want nothing to do with each other. But when a high-stakes business opportunity requires them to appear as a happily married couple, the former lovers are forced back under the same roof.

As they struggle to maintain the illusion, unresolved feelings and painful memories begin to resurface. Meanwhile, Runchlaphat’s controlling mother, Gingkamol, remains determined to keep Peeracha out of the family at all costs. Surrounded by deception, pride, and lingering desire, the ex-wives find themselves trapped between the love they once shared and the wounds they never healed.

items.title: The Story of Pearl Girl
items.description: After narrowly escaping an abusive pearl farm, a young woman with unmatched talent carves out her own fate as treachery meets the world of jewelry.

items.title: Back From the Brink
items.description: Tian Yao is a dragon spirit who was betrayed by his lover and stripped of his dragon bones. He meets Yan Hui, a free-spirited young maiden who holds the key to help him regain his powers and his faith in love. Mysteries will abound as Yan Hui come to learn of her true origin.

items.title: The Great Queen
items.description: Modern girl Xi Yuan travels to the realm of Xuanji, where she faces numerous dangers, and her true identity and hidden powers gradually emerge. With the realm's safety at stake, Xi Yuan bravely confronts significant challenges, demonstrating her courage and resilience while striving to protect those around her.

items.title: The One
items.description: A successful lawyer who has shut herself off from love after enduring betrayal and painful experiences finds her guarded life changed when a young man from her past returns after five years.

items.title: Our Sticky Love
items.description: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

items.title: Pull Strings
items.description: Li Changshou, a terminally ill patient in his previous life, is reborn into the Primordial World as a low-level Qi cultivator who cherishes life and avoids all karmic entanglements. Determined to dodge the great calamity foretold by the Heavenly Dao, he adopts the "Way of Steady" — his ultimate goal being to secure a humble post in the Heavenly Court and survive quietly. He operates with extreme caution: when still, he's as steady as an old dog; when he moves, he shakes the heavens. He firmly believes the era of bloodshed is over — better to trick than to kill, better to stay single than to fall in love. Yet enemies and beauties keep surging toward him like tides. Before he knows it, he becomes a mastermind pulling strings behind the scenes, entangled in power plays among multiple factions, orchestrating the "Dragon Clan's ascent to Heaven" — and even the great calamity itself accelerates toward him…

items.title: Never-Ending Summer
items.description: To save her gravely ill grandmother, top student Zhou Wan approaches her mother's stepson, Lu Xixiao, for funds. They fall for each other over the summer after graduation but are torn apart by misunderstandings in reality. Ten years later, they reunite at work. Though Lu Xixiao harbors resentment, his love for Zhou Wan remains. As they uncover the truth behind a "factory accident," they resolve their differences and reunite.

items.title: New Boyfriend
items.description: A story about the love and relationships of people in an office, a place that is not only a workplace but also a place where someone's feelings are made clear.

items.title: My Summer of You
items.description: Bound by a shared love of film, two high school boys spend a life-changing summer falling for each other.

items.title: The K2
items.description: A patriotic bodyguard who was abandoned by his country and colleagues, a hidden daughter of leading Presidential candidate who regards love as a tool for revenge, and the First Lady contender who hides her ambition and charisma behind a kind and friendly personality.

items.title: 365 Days
items.description: A woman falls victim to a dominant mafia boss, who imprisons her and gives her one year to fall in love with him.

items.title: Born Again
items.description: After being murdered at her own wedding by those closest to her, a top influencer becomes trapped in an endless time loop. With each resurrection, she uncovers more of the conspiracy and joins forces with a doctor who remembers the loops to prevent the tragedy before it happens.

items.title: Take Charge of My Heart
items.description: A powerful chaebol heir with an artificial heart on the verge of powering down enters a contract romance with a screenwriter who can literally recharge him, sparking an electric love story amid corporate intrigue and ticking deadlines.

items.title: Dream to You
items.description: Dreaming of filmmaking, a passionate high schooler pushes aside all obligations to create short films, inspiring a studious but passionless classmate. Their deep bond eventually turns romantic, but they are abruptly separated when he is forced to move overseas. Years later in their thirties, their lives have completely swapped: she is a disillusioned, struggling TV reporter, while he has become an award-winning director. When a sudden reunion brings them face-to-face, he resolves to help her rediscover her lost spark, but she still harbors deep resentment over his past disappearance.

items.title: The Road to Splendor
items.description: After being falsely accused of a scandal that ruins her reputation, noblewoman Fu Tingyun escapes with the help of salt smuggler Zhao Ling. Together, they expose government corruption and navigate the treacherous world of court politics. As they seek justice and uncover the truth behind her past, their bond deepens, leading them to a new beginning.

items.title: Overdo
items.description: In Republican Shanghai, Murong Qingyi, a warlord’s son swapped at birth, endures years of torment. His life changes when Ren Susu saves him, but tragedy strikes her family because of it.Years later, love sparks between them, but Ren Susu fakes her death to save another, leaving Qingyi heartbroken.Three years on, she returns as his future sister-in-law. Love, hate, betrayal, and old wounds resurface. As war looms, the two must defy fate together, but can love survive a nation’s fall?

items.title: Spooky in Love
items.description: When a ghost-seeing heir and an ace prosecutor learn that a single touch makes them a strangely effective duo, they team up to crack unsolved murders.

items.title: Hanyi Enters the Heart
items.description: After surviving her family's massacre as a child, a young woman assumes a new identity and spends years preparing for revenge. With an alliance of women at her side, she hunts down those responsible while searching for the mysterious figure behind the killings.

items.title: Genie, Make a Wish
items.description: After a thousand years, a quirky genie returns to grant wishes to a woman born without feelings. Can his magic bring love and wonder to her world?

items.title: The Edge of Horizon
items.description: Years after being torn apart by rank and tradition, a prince and his first love reunite as buried feelings bloom once more.

items.title: The Fire
items.description: In the South, 'Fai' Atchima Watinwanich reunites with rival 'Kaprao' Athitaya Thitsama, a spark that could kindle love or reopen old wounds.

items.title: Dearest
items.description: After witnessing a murder, famous actress, Wen Jianan, is framed for a deadly accident and stripped of everything she has. As she joins forces with Jiang Yu, a man seeking revenge, they uncover a conspiracy that binds their families together.

items.title: My Husband Is a Mafia Boss
items.description: Join the sweet and naïve Aemie as she navigates married life with mafia boss husband Zeke, and the dangerous world she’s about to enter.

items.title: The Servant Prince
items.description: After losing his wealth and status, a former high school golden boy finds himself under the care of the outcast classmate he once treated as his servant.

items.title: A Winter Sun Wakes the Wind in Spring Hills' Dream
items.description: Seeking refuge in the mountains, a famous actor falls for a tea farmer, where love blooms between two vastly different worlds.

items.title: Play Me
items.description: The top star Jung Yihyun, who started as a child actor, decides to quit the entertainment industry due to his mother's sudden death. Kang Jaewon, a part-time worker who lives from hand to mouth, has to temporarily give up his actor dream due to real-life pressures. The two, who had a falling-out in high school due to a misunderstanding, reunite years later because of a musical. Through portraying the characters, they rediscover love.

items.title: S&X
items.description: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.

items.title: Ren Yu
items.description: A missing person case forces three girls from different walks of life to face life-altering choices, exposing the ups and downs of an ordinary family. The story intertwines the light and dark sides of the city—above ground and in the underground tunnels. As one girl navigates these challenges alone, she uncovers the truth, finds redemption, and moves toward a hopeful future.

items.title: Street World Fighter: Directors’ War
items.description: A global spin-off of the highly popular Street Woman/Man Fighter franchise, this series shifts the focus from dance crews to the high-profile performance directors and choreographers who shape K-pop stages.

items.title: After Moving Seats, The Boy Behind Me Has A Crush On Me
items.description: A simple seating change sparks an unlikely romance when the most popular boy in school confesses to his quiet classmate.

items.title: Blue Lips
items.description: Curiosity gives way to a passionate and complex romance between a reserved shop owner and a rebellious musician.

items.title: Are the Sexy Buttocks Not Good?
items.description: A chance rescue reunites a college student with his company’s CEO, where an unlikely workplace romance begins to bloom.

items.title: The Vacation Principle
items.description: After losing her job, a woman retreats to her late grandmother's seaside villa, where an unexpected friendship with its mysterious caretaker helps her heal and embrace a new beginning.

items.title: Snow Fall
items.description: In Republican-era China, a century-old vampire survives a brutal assassination attempt with the help of a mortal blind girl. Both lonely souls, they soon find companionship amidst danger and chaos. But can their bond overcome their differences?

items.title: Snowy Night Timeless Love
items.description: The unrestrained swordsman Huo Zhanbai seeks medicine for a friend's child and encounters the pharmacist Xue Ziye. Over eight years of daily interaction, they progress from having their own convictions to deepening understanding, mutual redemption, and a promise to meet under a plum tree the following year. However, due to the responsibilities they bear, they find it difficult to express their love, leaving behind a regret of eternal separation. Amidst the joyous toasts in the snowy night and a farewell across a thousand miles, a poignant and unforgettable missed opportunity unfolds—a love destined to be unable to endure, depicting a tale of redemption and letting go in a life-and-death romance.

items.title: Spring of Youth
items.description: A K-pop star, Sa-gye, reluctantly enters college, forms a 4-member mixed band, and navigates love and growth through music amid the chaos of campus life.

items.title: Tempest
items.description: Seo Munju, a highly accomplished diplomat and former ambassador to the United Nations, and Sanho, an international special agent shrouded in a veil of secrets, race to uncover the truth behind an attack that threatens the future stability of the Korean peninsula.

items.title: The Apartment Job
items.description: Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.

items.title: Everyone Loves Me
items.description: On the day Yue Qianling resigned, she coincidentally crossed paths with her secret crush, Gu Xun, who had just joined as the head of the 9th Business Unit. She didn't hesitate to return to the company to boldly pursue Gu Xun, but he remained indifferent. He even harshly rejected her confession in front of the entire school. Little did she know, Gu Xun had long fallen for his fearless online friend "Sticky Dough Twist". Who would have expected that his online friend turned out to be Yue Qianling herself? Upon discovering the truth, Gu Xun had no choice but to embark on a humorous and heartwarming "reverse pursuit" journey.

items.title: Night Tales
items.description: After being betrayed by her lover and mentor, a talented winemaker assumes the identity of an illegitimate heiress to infiltrate a powerful family. As her carefully laid plans unfold, hidden agendas threaten to destroy everyone involved.

items.title: Bittersweet Love
items.description: A poor young man trapped in a sham marriage falls for his wife’s older brother, risking everything for forbidden love.

items.title: Mystic Nine
items.description: Mystic Nine follows Zhang Qishan as he joins forces with Wu Laogou, alongside Huo Xiangu and the other members of the Mystic Nine, when turmoil returns to Changsha. The mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a century-old secret. Faced with life-and-death choices, bound by brotherhood, responsibility to their sects, and devotion to their country, they risk everything to protect their home and overcome the crisis.

items.title: Derailment
items.description: Do you believe that there exist countless parallel universes that are exactly like the world you live in? Jiang Xiaoyuan finds herself struggling with her identity as she travels across parallel universes that never seem to intersect. In her original world, she is an invincible wealthy daughter, but in another place, she becomes an ordinary working girl who has absolutely nothing. Along the way, she meets the mysterious Qi Lian and together, they search for the truth involving the mystery surrounding her. Stripped of wealth, family background, appearance, and education, Jiang Xiaoyuan sets herself on a journey to find pieces of her "real" identity.

items.title: Go Back Lover
items.description: Upon transferring to Xingcheng Mingli High School, Shen Xingruo lived under the same roof as Lu Xingyan and attended the same class. Over the course of a year and a half, their relationship evolved from initial animosity to gradually developing feelings for each other. Years later, they are reunited through, "Go Back Lover," a reality show for exes, first love, and the nostalgia of youth between high school friends.

items.title: To Love & Cherish
items.description: To help support her family, Daran gave up her dreams of higher education to start working immediately after high school. Unfortunately, she struggles to find work, eventually taking a job as a security guard at a broadcasting company. But unexpectedly, she runs into her ex-boyfriend Rangsiman, now a powerful television executive. Daran and Rangsiman were deeply in love in their teens, but separated over painful misunderstandings and secrets kept from each other. Rangsiman himself is now engaged to another woman, but he finds himself drawn back to Daran, wanting to understand why she broke up with him and what led her to her current life circumstances. Can they find a way to forgive each other – and will they rekindle their old spark?

items.title: Youthful Glory
items.description: When General Jiang Xu returns to the capital after eight years to investigate military corruption, he enters a strategic marriage with a strong-willed noblewoman, Ming Tan. As they navigate political intrigue and work to protect their families, an unexpected romance gradually blossoms between them.

items.title: My Troublesome Star
items.description: A romantic comedy that follows the story of a top actress who, after reaching the peak of her career and even winning the youngest-ever Best Actress award, suffers an accident and finds herself transported 25 years into the future.

items.title: Beyond the Bar
items.description: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

items.title: Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
items.description: As a professional billiards player, Yin Guo has become quite a notable athlete. After receiving an invitation to play in a tournament in Hel, Yin Guo eagerly accepts. Little does she know that meeting former professional billiards player, Lin Yiyang, in Hel will change her life forever.

items.title: Law and the City
items.description: Story of a lawyer who is known for his good appearance and straightforward personality and is working with Gyeongmin Law Firm for 9 years.

items.title: When Light Fades
items.description: During Thailand’s 1976 crackdown, a fugitive student finds love with a guerrilla fighter while battling for freedom and survival.

items.title: Genius Girlfriend
items.description: A genius girl and her childhood sweetheart navigate life's challenges from campus to marriage in this heartwarming coming-of-age story filled with wit, warmth and youthful passion.

items.title: Alice in Borderland Season 2
items.description: With his two friends, a video-game-obsessed young man finds himself in a strange version of Tokyo where they must compete in dangerous games to win.

items.title: Alice in Borderland Season 3
items.description: With his two friends, a video-game-obsessed young man finds himself in a strange version of Tokyo where they must compete in dangerous games to win.

items.title: Alice in Borderland
items.description: With his two friends, a video-game-obsessed young man finds himself in a strange version of Tokyo where they must compete in dangerous games to win.

items.title: Story of Kunning Palace
items.description: A fallen queen, Jiang Xuening who aspired to have the highest power and authority in her life was held hostage by rebels after the king, Shen Jie was poisoned. In this life, she used everyone around her to reach the authority of the queen but in the end, she remained under house arrest and Xie Wei slaughtered the entire city. Later, she received the decree to be buried with the emperor. She got a second chance to change her fate by not entering the palace but when she woke up after rebirth, she was already messing around. Even though she vowed not to enter the palace, a certain turn of events again entangles her with the palace and Xie Wei whom she hated the most.

items.title: The Queen of Attack
items.description: After being betrayed and left disfigured when a lookalike steals her identity, Lin Hong'er receives a new face and a new name from a mysterious healer. Now living as Hong Linlang, she sets out on a path of revenge against the powerful family that destroyed her life and to reclaim her lost love.

items.title: Keeping Up with Beauty
items.description: After a courageous general named Fu Yunyun time-travels into the body of a wealthy heiress, she becomes entangled in a web of love and deception. As she searches for the truth behind an ancient promise, Fu Yunyun must rely on her strength and wit to find her place in a world both familiar and strange.

items.title: Her Phoenix Majesty
items.description: Wandering scholar Xie Yuan accidentally enters a matriarchal kingdom where women take multiple husbands. Admired for his looks, he’s forcibly taken by the eldest princess to become her consort. Refusing to yield, Xie Yuan plans his escape, but when the gentle second princess aids him, he’s drawn into a dangerous struggle of power and deceit within the royal palace.

items.title: AI Girl
items.description: One day, a package arrives at quirky introvert Gen's doorstop. When she opens the package, she discovers a truly human-like robot, beautiful like the girl of Gen's dreams. While trying to find a way to send the robot back, Gen accidentally hits a button that has the robot opening her eyes and coming to life. With the beautiful, flirtatious, playful and sexy robot by her side, Gen is completely swayed and decides to keep her, giving her the name Ai.

items.title: Royal Betrothal
items.description: Meng Tinghui, the first female scholar, climbs power through cunning, fueled by devotion to the emperor who saved her. Unaware of his love, their bond is marred by her infamy.

items.title: A Shop for Killers Season 2
items.description: A niece who lost her parents and grew up in the hands of an uncle who runs a shopping mall faces a new truth after her uncle's sudden death.

items.title: The Maid
items.description: Shen Yuqing, a mistreated noblewoman’s daughter, assumes a new identity to seek revenge and expose political conspiracies. With the help of Regent Prince Pei Ji, they battle powerful enemies, face deadly trials, and protect their family.

items.title: Fourever You Part 2
items.description:
The tangled relationships within Easter and North’s friend group begin to stir once again.

Typhoon reunites with his former next-door older brother, Tonfah, only to find that the secret they left behind still hurts. Even so, he’s willing to return to Tonfah’s life in any way he can.

Daotok, the artistic boy who can speak to spirits, is reluctantly pulled by his neighbor Arthit into searching for the soul of his late mother. Yet the more they chase after the dead, the more their living hearts fill with something new.

Tiger, the lonely youngest son of a powerful family, meets classmate Dueannao during football tryouts. Their first clash turns into warmth—one that makes Tiger want to cross the line from friendship into something more.

Three pairs. Tears, goodbyes, and the fragile line between friends and something deeper—begin once more.

items.title: Boys In Love
items.description: This semester, studious Shane is tasked with tutoring feckless and flirtatious Kit. Meanwhile, just when Kim is ready to give up on love, new kid Mon arrives and it's love at first sight.

items.title: The Husband
items.description: Kang Tae-ju, a former neurosurgeon who now serves as a hospital director struggling to face a dangerous criminal in order to save his wife, who was kidnapped before their divorce.

items.title: Your Sunshine
items.description: Lu Ye flees abroad to escape a family debt and returns to Tang City years later to investigate her sister’s mysterious death. Teaming up with her former brother-in-law, Yin Zhuofeng, she joins a secret resistance group to uncover the truth behind a powerful underground organization. As they face danger and uncover long-buried family secrets, an unexpected romance begins to blossom.

items.title: Her Straight Punch Rule
items.description: After nearly dying, champion fighter Shen Zhixia transmigrates into a parallel world and becomes a bullied wealthy bride trapped in a powerful family marriage. As she uses her combat skills to fight back against her enemies, her cold CEO husband gradually falls for her while she struggles between returning home and embracing her new life.

items.title: Sword and Beloved
items.description: The drama series revolves around Wangquan Fugui, who is trained as the ultimate demon-slayer of the Yiqi Alliance since childhood, meeting Qing Tong, a spider demon who infiltrates Wangquan Manor as a spy. Qing Tong’s presence allows Fugui to broaden his horizon and change his view on demons. Yearning for freedom, Fugui’s fervor for attaining world peace is gradually ignited. After experiencing extreme agony, he leaves Wangquan Manor with Qing Tong, embarking on a journey of self-enlightenment.

items.title: My CEO in Disguise
items.description: Gao Feng, a retired tycoon disguised as a delivery man, is hired by CEO Su Qingyan to be her fake husband, unaware he’s the real boss she wants to impersonate. As they enter a contract marriage, their hidden identities and growing feelings complicate everything.

items.title: Footprints of Change
items.description: Set in a Western-style house in Shanghai's French Concession, the film spans decades of change. Once home to the Lin family, the house is transformed into a maternity hospital in the 1930s, then a factory in the 1950s after the founding of the People's Republic of China. By the 1990s, it becomes a mixed-use building, with each era bringing new stories of the people passing through its doors.

items.title: The Murky Stream
items.description: The fates of a man with a hidden past, a wise and just woman, and an upright man intertwine.

items.title: The Promise of the Soul
items.description: After a fall swaps his soul into his grandson’s body, a 69-year-old man confronts college, queer romance, and the chaos of first love—all at once.

items.title: What's Wrong with Secretary Kim
items.description: Lee Young-joon's family runs a large company and he works as the vice-president of the company. He is smart, rich and handsome, but he is arrogant. His secretary is Kim Mi-so. She has worked for him for years and she is perfect for him, but Kim Mi-so decides to quit her job.

items.title: Love in the Moonlight
items.description: In 1963 Bangkok, a prince sent for an arranged marriage finds his heart drawn instead to his fiancée’s cousin, forcing him to choose between love and duty.

items.title: The Shadow Sovereign
items.description: A low-born scholar rises to power to avenge his father, only to find an unexpected alliance and deep love with the defiant princess he once vowed to destroy.

items.title: Spring Over Phoenix Pond
items.description: Qi Yuan, a butcher’s daughter who is secretly the true heiress of a noble family, suffers betrayal and persecution at the hands of a false heiress. After becoming a guard for Prince Jing, Xiao Yunting, she develops feelings for him. However, tragedy strikes on their wedding night, leading to her death. Reborn, Qi Yuan sets out to change her fate, seeking revenge and a second chance at love.

items.title: Snapping Golden Bough
items.description: After being forced into a marriage with the Second Prince, Shen Suhe suffers betrayal and loses everything before meeting a tragic end. Reborn on her wedding day, Shen Suhe disguises herself to uncover the truth behind her family's downfall and joins forces with Prince Mu Yunzheng to seek justice.

items.title: Sin And Love
items.description: Police officers, drug dealers, and spies: a mysterious kidnapping uncovers a criminal network, while love and sex become tools of exchange.

items.title: Hi-Five
items.description: In the dead of night, a body donated for organ transplants mysteriously disintegrates into ashes. Soon after, five recipients, given a heart, corneas, lungs, liver, and kidneys, begin to develop supernatural powers. A teenage girl gains immense strength, a hipster manipulates electromagnetic waves, a novelist summons powerful gusts, a factory manager can heal others, and a woman discovers a strange, still-unidentified ability. Together, they form a reluctant but heroic team known as "HI-FIVE." But they aren't the only ones transformed. A cult leader who received the donor’s pancreas gains the terrifying power to drain life energy and sets his sights on stealing the abilities of HI-FIVE to achieve godlike domination.

items.title: Love Algorithm
items.description: A dating reality show writer reunites with his estranged high school best friend after casting the popular singer in the show's latest season.

items.title: Love For You
items.description: In the 1990s, teenagers Chen Yi and Miao Jing met due to their parents, initially getting off to a rocky start. However, Miao Jing's kindness eventually softens Chen Yi's attitude towards her. Chen Yi and Miao Jing's relationship deepens after Chen Yi's father dies and Miao Jing's mother disappears, leaving the two to rely only on each other. Miao Jing eventually confesses her feelings for Chen Yi, but he pushes her away after he gets tangled up as a crime witness, urging her to leave their city. Years later, Chen Yi runs a billiards hall in their hometown, while Miao Jing returns for a work assignment. But when Chen Yi suspects that Miao Jing's boss is involved in smuggling, he vows to protect her – and stay by her side.

items.title: Marry My Husband: Japan
items.description: Misa has been a supporting character all her life, blindly trusting her best friend and husband. When she discovers their affair, the betrayal results in her death. Waking up ten years in the past, Misa vows to become the main character of her own story. She plans to ruin her betrayers by making them marry each other, but after meeting her director at work, starts to consider who she truly is.

items.title: Revamp: The Undead Story
items.description: After his blood frees a century-old vampire trapped in a painting, an antique dealer must help him regain his powers before deadly Hunters close in.

items.title: Bad Guy My Boss
items.description: When his rivals set eyes on his devoted assistant, a powerful CEO must shed his bad-boy facade to prove his love is real.

items.title: My Boss
items.description: Cheng Yao, aspiring to be a lawyer, joins a top law firm and moves into an apartment near work—only to discover her housemate is her new boss, Qian Heng. Initially harsh and suspicious, Qian Heng puts her through rigorous training, believing she got the job through connections. As Cheng Yao proves her talent and determination, she changes his impression, and a reluctant admiration slowly turns into romance.

items.title: True Beauty
items.description: After being bullied and discriminated because of her ugly looks, a high school girl transforms herself into a gorgeous "goddess" and quickly rises to fame after mastering the art of makeup via online tutorial videos.

items.title: You Are My Glory
items.description: Qiao Jingjing, a celebrity, and Yu Tu, an aerospace engineer were high school classmates. Qiao Jingjing confessed to Yu Tu twice but was rejected both times. Ten years later, Qiao Jingjing became a top celebrity. She wants to become the endorser of a video game but was exposed that her gaming skills are super bad. By chance, she meets Yu Tu, who is now an aerospace engineer and is currently feeling lost about his career. Under Qiao Jingjing's set-up, Yu Tu becomes her gaming coach. They slowly fall in love over time.

items.title: Lioness Season 3
items.description: Cruz Manuelos, a rough-around-the-edges but passionate young Marine, is recruited to join the CIA's Lioness Engagement Team to help bring down a terrorist organization from within. Joe, the station chief of the Lioness program, is tasked with training, managing and leading her female undercover operatives.

items.title: The Devil's Mouth
items.description: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

items.title: House of the Dragon Season 3
items.description: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne. But when Viserys later fathers a son, the court is shocked when Rhaenyra retains her status as his heir, and seeds of division sow friction across the realm.

items.title: Love Alert
items.description: A carefree playboy volunteers to walk a classmate home to get close to his crush, only to unexpectedly fall for the classmate's gentle older brother.

items.title: When I Fly Towards You
items.description: Set off by a sweet chance encounter, 16-year-old Su Zaizai finds herself helplessly drawn to Zhang Lurang — her smart, charming yet distant schoolmate.

items.title: When the Phone Rings
items.description: A rising politician and his mute wife's tense marriage begins to unravel after a call from a kidnapper turns their lives upside down.

items.title: Falling Into Your Smile
items.description: After joining an all-male e-sports team, an amateur gamer tests her skills and leads her team to the world championships.

items.title: Key to the Phoenix Heart
items.description: The evil general forcefully marries the money-grubbing fake heiress who is obsessed with mechanical arts. From a contractual couple to exposing each other's true identities in a life-and-death situation, their mutual love and hatred intensify. They uncover court conspiracies, shatter deadly chaos, and safeguard the peace of the nation.

items.title: Cutie Pie 2 You (UNCUT)
items.description: Arranged to marry, a young tycoon and a free-spirited student face a test when one reveals that only duty, not love, keeps them together.

items.title: We Are
items.description: A group of university friends navigate academics, friendships, and romance as they deal with the ups and downs of campus life.

items.title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
items.description: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs — proving love endures across time.

items.title: Head 2 Head
items.description: A rivalry turns upside down when Jerome’s strange new ability shows him a shocking future—one where his enemy becomes his soulmate.

items.title: Payback
items.description: A grieving debt collector enters the entertainment world for revenge, only to fall into a dangerous attraction with a powerful executive.

items.title: Peach and Me
items.description: After their wedding, Thee and Peach embrace the joys and chaos of married life while finding their own rhythm together.

items.title: Squid Game Season 3
items.description: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

items.title: Squid Game Season 2
items.description: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

items.title: Squid Game
items.description: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

items.title: Bitch X Rich Season 2
items.description: Kim Hye-in has to transfer to Cheongdam International High School after witnessing a murder. She crosses paths with Baek Je-na, a bully who happens to be connected to the case.

items.title: Can This Love Be Translated?
items.description: The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

items.title: A Dog and a Plane
items.description: After a chaotic luggage mix-up, a broke paramedic and an ambitious flight attendant grow closer while exposing a cheating boyfriend’s secrets.

items.title: Kill Me Love Me
items.description: In a land torn by war, the three kingdoms of Dayan, Xiyan, and Nanyue have battled for years. Prince Murong Jinghe of Dayan, renowned for his military prowess, suffers a devastating betrayal, leading to the annihilation of his army. Determined to uncover the truth behind the treachery, he seeks justice while navigating the treacherous court politics. Amid this turmoil, Mei Lin, a warrior presumed dead, becomes Murong’s only ally in his quest for revenge. As they fight together, a complex bond forms between them, blending love and sacrifice, as they both struggle to survive and seek justice.

items.title: A Dream Within a Dream
items.description: When Song Xiaoyu is unexpectedly pulled into a scripted world as a tragic heroine fated to be discarded by the villainous male lead, she tries to escape, only to be trapped in an endless loop of fatal outcomes each time she strays from the plot. No matter how hard she resists, the story keeps pushing her toward Nan Heng, the cold and calculating lead. As she navigates this paper-thin world where every character is bound by fate, Song Xiaoyu must fight not just for her survival, but for control over her own story.

items.title: Deep In
items.description: Filming a daring romance movie, an award-winning actor and an ambitious newcomer lose track of where acting ends and their real desire begins.

items.title: In Blossom
items.description: In the sinful city of Heyang, very well-liked Pan Yue married Yang Caiwei, who was despised by everyone. However, Yang Caiwei was murdered on their wedding day. The suspected culprit was none other than Pan Yue. Reborn from death, Yang Caiwei was under the guise of the "wicked woman" Shangguan Zhi. She returned with a fierce demeanor, intending to expose Pan Yue's true colors. As they bravely confronted the Four Major Clans and uncovered the old cases, their hearts drew closer once more. Yang Caiwei discovered that the true culprit was not Pan Yue, who had loved her deeply all along. Just as things seemed to be falling into place, the mastermind behind the scenes set another trap, pushing them into the abyss of despair.

items.title: Guardian: The Lonely and Great God
items.description: In his quest for a bride to break his immortal curse, a 939-year-old guardian of souls meets a grim reaper and a sprightly student with a tragic past.

items.title: Me and Who
items.description: After waking up in a billionaire heir’s body, a broke man’s secret unravels when his mind-reading fiancé discovers the truth on their first date.

items.title: A(ir) Moment
items.description: After humanity destroys the world, four men wake up in a barren, forgotten land with no memories or technology. As they struggle to survive, tangled emotions—love, jealousy, and longing—emerge. In a world stripped of meaning, will they find hope or fall together?

items.title: Vincenzo
items.description: During a visit to his motherland, a Korean-Italian mafia lawyer gives an unrivaled conglomerate a taste of its own medicinewith a side of justice.

items.title: Heart Code
items.description: After the attempted attack on a senior police officer, the Special Crime Suppression Unit launches a training camp to identify elite female officers. Among them is Captain Thara, a well-known officer who grows close to Vicky, unaware that Vicky is the daughter of the senior officer linked to her father’s death 19 years ago.

items.title: Flex X Cop
items.description: A chaebol cop joins forces with a gritty detective to take down criminals with a touch of wealth and a whole lot of wit.

items.title: Lover Merman
items.description: A newcomer to an island bar falls for its star bartender, unaware he’s a merman—while a protective friend warns that love between human and merman spells tragedy.

items.title: 4 Destiny Project
items.description: A collection of four BL series, directed by four visionary directors- get ready for an emotional roller coaster.

items.title: Reset
items.description: Killed by betrayal on the night of his greatest triumph, an actor wakes 25 years earlier—ready to rewrite his fate and crush rivals who ruined him.

items.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
items.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

items.title: Leviticus
items.description: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most — each other.

items.title: The Jewel of Section E
items.description: Jay-jay, the only girl in the mischievous Section E, hopes for a fresh start in high school but quickly becomes the target of her rowdy male classmates' pranks and schemes to make her leave. Dubbed their "Mutya" (muse), she fights back with wit and charm, turning the tables on her tormentors. Amidst the chaos, unexpected friendships blossom, and hilarious misunderstandings lead to heart-fluttering moments. Can Jay-jay survive the madness of Section E, or will she win over their hearts instead?

items.title: Gorgeous Dream
items.description: Labeled as tainted after four years in prison, Shen Wanqing is destroyed by the Liu family to protect their reputation. Reborn with a new face as Lan Mengyan, she marries into the Liu household to seek revenge, drawing both father and son into her trap. But as her plan places her in growing danger, the mysterious Qin Moxiu—who has been watching from the shadows—steps in.

items.title: Voyage to Haihun Season 2
items.description: Wang Heng, a disillusioned modern man, is transported to the Western Han dynasty, where he meets De Jiu, a warrior woman who resembles his ex-girlfriend, and befriends the carefree Prince Liu He. Together, they attempt to change fate, but personal struggles and painful choices lead them on a journey of growth, redemption, and unexpected healing.

items.title: Voyage to Haihun
items.description: Wang Heng, a disillusioned modern man, is transported to the Western Han dynasty, where he meets De Jiu, a warrior woman who resembles his ex-girlfriend, and befriends the carefree Prince Liu He. Together, they attempt to change fate, but personal struggles and painful choices lead them on a journey of growth, redemption, and unexpected healing.

items.title: The Muse of Section E: The Dark Side
items.description: Jay-jay, the only girl in the mischievous Section E, hopes for a fresh start in high school but quickly becomes the target of her rowdy male classmates' pranks and schemes to make her leave. Dubbed their "Mutya" (muse), she fights back with wit and charm, turning the tables on her tormentors. Amidst the chaos, unexpected friendships blossom, and hilarious misunderstandings lead to heart-fluttering moments. Can Jay-jay survive the madness of Section E, or will she win over their hearts instead?

items.title: Alchemy of Souls Season 2: Light and Shadow
items.description: A powerful sorceress in a blind woman's body encounters a man from a prestigious family, who wants her help to change his destiny.

items.title: Alchemy of Souls
items.description: A powerful sorceress in a blind woman's body encounters a man from a prestigious family, who wants her help to change his destiny.

items.title: Xiao Fang
items.description: It tells the story of Yang Xiaofang and Qi Xiaowei from the same village, who become pregnant before marriage. Yang's family rushes back to the village to strategize for Xiaofang. The Qi and Yang families have completely different attitudes, unexpectedly sparking a "marital storm." After negotiations between the two families fail, Xiaofang starts "blind dates while pregnant" — and surprisingly finds herself courted by the whole village, setting off a series of hilarious and laugh-out-loud events.

items.title: When Oranges Fall
items.description: In the 90s, two polar-opposite classmates with the same nickname find their mutual dislike turning to love after a stray orange brings them together.

items.title: Blossoms of Power
items.description: Gu Qingzhi, the surviving daughter of a massacred family, returns as Princess Shen Xihe from the northwest. Transformed from a proud border rose into a cold and ruthless ruler, she seeks to control her own destiny. Alongside the sharp and strategic Crown Prince Xiao Huayong, who hides his true strength, they navigate political intrigue and rise to power together.

items.title: Smile After Tears
items.description: After a tragic accident tears them apart, a cheerful student finds healing and unexpected love through the boy who stayed beside him.

items.title: Your Love So Invincible
items.description: Anna Kusakabe had it all: a high-powered career at a prestigious management consulting firm and a reputation for excellence. But when she abruptly resigns, she claims it’s to pursue financial independence and early retirement. In reality, her life is a chaotic patchwork of whims and temporary gigs. While organizing receipts for a struggling design studio, Anna crosses paths with Mizuki Seo, a brilliant yet notoriously ill-tempered character designer. Though she tries to keep her distance, she can’t ignore his tendency to accept exploitative work from shady clients. What begins as a simple attempt to intervene quickly spirals into an unexpected partnership. As Anna steps into the creative world to help Mizuki, the two polar opposites find their lives – and their professional futures – inextricably linked. Can Anna find the true independence she seeks, or will this messy collaboration change her life forever?

items.title: Sword Rose
items.description:
After an emergency rescue thrusts her into the spotlight, police officer Hua Deng Yan is unexpectedly appointed as the new director of Tianhai City’s Anti-Human Trafficking Office. Facing skepticism from her team, including a seasoned former undercover officer, she must prove her capabilities in a high-stakes environment.

As the team tackles complex cases of abduction and exploitation, Deng Yan’s determination and leadership begin to shine. Through relentless investigations and growing trust within the unit, they uncover clues pointing to a hidden and far-reaching criminal network.

Together, they confront not only the dangers of their mission but also the personal struggles that come with fighting for justice on the front lines.

items.title: Whale Store xoxo
items.description: After inheriting her father's struggling store, Wan bonds with a charming regular who offers to help, but her new friend's family have other ideas.

items.title: ClaireBell
items.description: Fate led Bell, an unfortunate young woman, into prison, where she had to struggle for survival alone, without hope. That was until Claire, a mysterious female inmate, appeared to help her. And from that moment on... the encounter between these two souls began to fill this dark and desolate place with a small glimmer of light, one that gradually grew into love.

items.title: Rose and Gun
