items.title: My Romance Scammer
items.description: After marrying a con artist for love, a billionaire heir must navigate a messy prenuptial trap while his cousin falls for another scammer.

items.title: Bridgerton
items.description: Wealth, lust, and betrayal set in the backdrop of Regency era England, seen through the eyes of the powerful Bridgerton family.

items.title: Cat for Cash
items.description: To pay his mother's debt, a cat-hater must work with a handsome feline lover, unaware that the man is the very person he owes money to.

items.title: Quest of Heroic Hearts
items.description: The reappearance of the legendary Tianzhan Sword plunges the martial world into turmoil, drawing the solitary swordsman Wei Gui and the hot-blooded youth Lei Lingze into a perilous quest that exposes a hidden conspiracy and tests their bond against betrayal and the fate of the realm.

items.title: How to Train Your Killer
items.description: On her wedding night, Crown Princess Gu Qingyao unexpectedly swaps souls with the assassin Shi Yi during an attempt on her husband’s life. Forced into a deadly game of deception and strategy, she fights to protect the crown prince while uncovering a far-reaching conspiracy that connects the imperial court with the martial world.

items.title: The Earth
items.description:
'Rose' Thippapha Amornjinda, heir to the Chomjan acreage, returns to Chiang Rai from America when her stepfather falls into a coma following a suspicious accident. There, she finds herself in danger from Wasu, a vineyard owner who seeks to force her into marriage and snatch up her land for his illegal business operations. Fortunately, Rose's childhood friend and owner of an organic vegetable farm 'Din' Kasama Watinwanich comes to protect her. To secure her safety, she and Din will have to marry.

Even if it's only a sham marriage, their reestablished closeness gradually brings about real feelings.

items.title: Love on the Turquoise Land
items.description: It tells the story of a secret organization of supernatural abilities called "Nanshan Hunters." It follows Nie Jiuluo and Yan Tuo, which initially their relationship starts off combative, but after several life-and-death collaborations, they gradually develop mutual trust and affection. Together, they confront the villain Di Xiao, protect love and peace, and ultimately become life partners.

items.title: Eternal Love of the Fox
items.description: Disguised as a palace maid to search for her missing father, Huo Xiangjiu uncovers that the powerful court favorite Feng Mochen is actually a thousand-year-old fox spirit. After an accidental soul swap binds them together, the unlikely pair must solve a string of strange palace cases, gradually uncovering a long-buried secret.

items.title: This Is the Feeling of Love
items.description: After her father’s sudden death, Zhen Beixing is drawn into a deadly corporate power struggle, relying on her enigmatic bodyguard Gu Chen for protection. As threats escalate and buried secrets begin to surface, she is pulled into a labyrinth of deception where reality and illusion blur, and Gu Chen’s true role in her fate remains unclear.

items.title: My Page in the 90s
items.description: A laugh-a-minute romantic comedy where a 2025 feelings coach gets zapped into a cheesy vintage novel and meets her match, a 1999 CEO who's sweet on the outside but shrewd within. In the ultimate battle of romantic tactics, who will out-scheme whom? To get home, influencer Lin Huan'er launches an operation to win over CEO Gao Haiming, only for her clever plans to hilariously backfire. Just as her ticket home appears, she realizes her heart has already checked in for good. Can this cross-storybook couple write their own happy ending?

items.title: Silent Truth
items.description: When a detective returns to his hometown to investigate a murder case, he uncovers shocking connections to the primary suspect and the weapon.

items.title: Peach Lover
items.description: A dedicated fan wins the chance to co-star with his favorite adult content creator, only for their work to turn into a real relationship.

items.title: Positively Yours
items.description: A man and a woman who swore off marriage find their carefully controlled lives overturned after a one-night mistake forces them into an unexpected, reverse romance neither planned nor wanted.

items.title: Secret by My Name
items.description: After taking over his family’s company, Tan Jianfei becomes locked in a corporate power struggle with his former lover Li Shujing, reigniting old feelings—unaware that she has returned to uncover the truth behind her father’s death, turning their romance into a dangerous game of love and revenge.

items.title: Dear Secretary
items.description: After three years working as a secretary, Lin Han decides to resign and start a new life. His boss, the poised CEO Qin Meili, tries her best to make him stay, but he’s determined to move on. As they prepare to say goodbye, both realize how much they’ve come to mean to each other.

items.title: Gimbap and Onigiri
items.description: A disillusioned former college track star working at a diner meets a tired Korean animation student struggling to find housing in Japan, and they instantly connect over an emotional moment involving a rice ball.

items.title: Countdown to Yes
items.description: Reunited with his first love after three years, Wataru must choose between protecting a lifelong friendship and risking it all for romance.

items.title: Glory in Shadows
items.description: Shen Yaochu is forced into a marriage with General Li Jingchuan, believed to be dead, only to discover he’s alive. After her mother’s tragic death, Shen Yaochu and Li Jingchuan join forces to unravel conspiracies and hidden plots within the Shen family, discovering trust and love along the way.

items.title: Poisonous Love
items.description: Dr. Prem, a flawless heart surgeon, faces chaos when her wedding is ruined by actress Pat. What begins as resentment soon turns into unexpected attraction after a fateful kiss reveals deeper feelings between them.

items.title: Love between Lines
items.description: Xiao Zhiyu and Hu Xiu are brought together by a Republic of China-themed murder mystery game. In the scripted NPC game filled with falling snow and spies in the shadows, the two ignite a fateful spark. An unexpected reunion in the real world reveals the mystery of each other's identities. The two shuttle between the misaligned time-spaces of reality and the script, and finally achieve two-way growth in the cross-dimensional bond, completing the transformation of love and self.

items.title: Spring Fever
items.description: After moving to a quiet rural town to heal from past heartbreak, a withdrawn teacher slowly rediscovers warmth and joy through her unexpected connection with a rough-around-the-edges but kindhearted local man.

items.title: The Spoiled Favorite
items.description: After transmigrating into the body of a burial concubine destined to die, modern graduate Lu Zhen'er refuses to accept her fate. When she discovers that the puppet emperor Xiao Wenjing is from her hometown, the two become entwined in a dangerous struggle against destiny—one in which he may be the only person who can change, or seal, her future.

items.title: To My Beloved Thief
items.description: A noblewoman who becomes a righteous bandit called Gil Dong, and Joseon Prince Yi Yeol who secretly investigates this bandit, only to find their souls mysteriously swapped, forcing them to work together and fall in love amidst intrigue, as they uncover conspiracies while protecting the people!

items.title: The Judge Returns
items.description: The return of corrupt judge Lee Han-young, who was a slave to a large law firm, to the past 10 years ago. He makes new choices to punish evil and implement justice.

items.title: Physical: Welcome to Mongolia
items.description: After completing the gruelling "Physical: Asia" finale, Team Mongolia leads their Korean teammates on a Mongolian trip of outdoor challenges and culture.

items.title: The Truth Within
items.description: The youngest forensic doctor in Licheng, Qi Sizhe, loses his girlfriend, Yu Fei, in a car accident. However, he soon uncovers a mysterious force behind the crash. Determined to find the truth, he joins the criminal investigation team in Hecheng, only to be caught in a series of bizarre, chilling cases. Victims long dead are wrapped in webs, and missing bodies appear preserved in formalin in the morgue. As he teams up with Zhu Qingyue and Han Feng, they break case after case. And the truth behind Yu Fei's death and the "Original Diamond" drug case begins to surface…

items.title: Glory (2025)
items.description: In a small-town boxing hub, two brothers investigate a shocking murder while navigating a troubled reunion with their father, a renowned coach.

items.title: Money Honey Brainy
items.description: After sabotaging a blind date, Xin Tong—a job-hopping part-time queen—becomes the contract girlfriend of wealthy heir Wen Pei’an to help him evade an arranged marriage, leading to a chaotic and comedic cohabitation romance.

items.title: The Unclouded Soul
items.description: For centuries, humans and demons have battled over the legendary Yuli Spring, a symbol of desire. Free-spirited Xiao Yao unexpectedly enters Ten Thousand Demons Valley, disrupting the demon world. There, she meets the powerful Demon King Hong Ye, who grows to admire her pure heart. Together, they face mysterious cases and formidable enemies, uncovering hidden truths along the way.

items.title: The Royal Highness of the Princess
items.description: After accidentally entering a script, struggling actress An Ran hides her true abilities to survive, only to become entangled in Yuwen Rui’s carefully laid revenge plan as a conspiracy threatens the fate of the kingdom.

items.title: Made in Korea
items.description: In 1970s South Korea, follow two men on opposite sides of power — one driven by ambition, the other by justice. As their worlds collide, greed, loyalty, and survival intertwine in a battle that will shape a nation.

items.title: A Vow in the Dark
items.description: Three hundred years after immortal fairy Jin Li seals Demon Lord Jie Chuan, a celestial beast named Jin Li accidentally frees him and is taken to the Demon Realm for her rare power. As enemies bound by fate, their hostility slowly turns into love—until a shocking truth about Jin Li's origin threatens to tear them apart and rewrite their destinies.

items.title: Spring Night
items.description: Orphan Mai Tian saves an injured, amnesiac crown prince and enters a fake marriage with him to escape an unwanted imperial decree. As they grow closer, their contractual union blossoms into genuine love, and together they work to restore her family’s honor.

items.title: Idol I (2025)
items.description: Maeng Se-na, a top star criminal lawyer who has been a fangirl for fifteen years, tries to prove her favorite idol’s innocence, who is suspected of murder.

items.title: The Ultimate Vow
items.description: After her family is massacred, Shen Qingru infiltrates the General’s household through marriage to seek revenge against the man she believes destroyed her life. Trapped within palace intrigue, she becomes entangled in a turbulent relationship of love and hatred, until the truth behind the massacre is revealed—forcing both to choose between vengeance, sacrifice, and redemption amid a brutal power struggle.

items.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker
items.description: As Bai Yue-Chu searches for a bride to foil his family's plans, a fox youkai falls through the roof.

items.title: Love Me (2025)
items.description: The Mathiesons, Clara (30s), Glen (60s) and Aaron (20s), find themselves at an emotional crossroads following an unexpected event that changes their lives forever.

items.title: Villains (2025)
items.description: A crime drama about bloody clashes and confrontations between villains over ultra-precise counterfeit 'supernotes'

items.title: The Architect
items.description: After her family is massacred on her wedding night, Shen Changning is miraculously reborn as Xi Yan, a dancer in Governor Pei Yu’s household. Using beauty and cunning as her weapons, she joins forces with Pei Yu to navigate a dangerous game of revenge and reclaim her destiny.

items.title: Melody of Secrets
items.description: An amnesiac journalist and a criminologist must work together to solve a string of brutal murders, slowly uncovering dangerous secrets in their past.

items.title: The Vendetta of An
items.description: Xie Huai'an, son of the Huben Army's creator, survives his family's massacre. After ten long years in hiding, he returns to Chang'an disguised as a lowly registrar, moving step by step through jianghu clashes and palace power plays in a tense battle of wits to avenge his family and safeguard the realm.

items.title: Will You Be My Manager
items.description: A student at a top entertainment school chases her dream of becoming a pop manager. Will a rival learn a secret from her past – and derail her plans?

items.title: Invisible Boys
items.description: A group of tangentially-connected gay teenagers in the remote coastal town of Geraldton encounter the thrills and devastations of first love and sexual discovery set against the backdrop of Australia voting to legalise same-sex marriage in 2017.

items.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
items.description: Percy Jackson is on a dangerous quest. Outrunning monsters and outwitting gods, he must journey across America to return Zeus's master bolt and stop an all-out war. With the help of his friends Annabeth and Grover, Percy's journey will lead him closer to the answers he seeks: how to fit into a world where he feels out of place, and who he's destined to be.

items.title: Supersensory Maze
items.description: Police academy professor Xu Jingzhi returns to investigate a strange case, where he teams up with his late brother’s friend, Zhuang Mingcheng. Together, they work to take down a criminal gang and solve an old case.

items.title: Silent Tides
items.description: He Ruoxian, Feng Baichuan, and the Shen brothers navigate wartime struggles in finance, espionage, and material transport in Macau during World War II. Though untouched by Japanese occupation, Macau becomes a crucial battleground where they courageously fight for the nation.

items.title: LuBan Mysteries
items.description: Master carpenter Li Mudun, famed for his skill with ancient Luban techniques, becomes the prime suspect in a series of eerie, superstition-filled murders. Determined to clear his name, Li teams up with detective Yang Zong and forensic doctor Su Qingyun. With reason and justice, the trio races to stop a new wave of killings and expose the truth behind the so-called “supernatural.”

items.title: Aligned Reverence
items.description: After a tragic mistake leads to the downfall of her benefactors, orphaned Su Jinyuan returns seeking redemption. Her fate becomes entwined with Xie Yunyuan, the adopted son of the fallen family. Together, they defy betrayal, fight to survive, and ignite a passionate, fate-defying love as they seek justice and reclaim their destiny.

items.title: Between Love and Frost
items.description: Chu Minghui survives her stepfather’s betrayal and the downfall of her family, hiding her identity to seek revenge. In the process, she enters a forbidden romance with the powerful young marshal Gu Tongpei, where love and vengeance become dangerously intertwined.

items.title: Pro Bono
items.description: When a respected judge's world falls apart overnight, he joins a top law firm's pro bono team — where hope and purpose wait in humble, unexpected places.

items.title: Match Play
items.description: A disciplined stuntman’s life changes when he coaches a popular idol who falls for him, forcing a choice between his quiet life and public love.

items.title: The Price of Confession
items.description: Accused of killing her husband, a woman is offered a way out by a mysterious stranger: in exchange for a confession in her place, she must commit murder.

items.title: Reborn from the Ashes
items.description: After being reborn as Su Qingran, a noblewoman betrayed and killed in her past life returns to seek justice for herself and her family. Fate brings her into a political marriage with Wanyan Jin, a man burdened by his own deep-seated vendetta. Though initially wary of each other, they join forces to uncover the truth, avenge their families, and find love as they fight side by side.

items.title: Sniper Butterfly
items.description: A captivating romance unfolds between a confident, cat-like woman and a bold, loyal younger man. As they navigate their differences, they find mutual healing and redemption, leading to a passionate, fate-driven love story full of tension and desire.

items.title: Extraordinary
items.description: In a world where everyone develops a power on their 18th birthday, Jen didn't. She's turning 25 and is still waiting to get hers. Adrift in a big, confusing world and armed with nothing but a bit of hope and a lot of desperation, Jen begins her journey to find her maybe-superpower. But in doing so, she might discover the joy of being just kind of ok.

items.title: Legend of the Magnate
items.description: A wrongfully accused scholar, Gu Pingyuan, becomes a fugitive and uses his intelligence to build a commercial empire. Starting as a merchant, he establishes himself in various industries, clashes with different merchant groups, and ultimately aims to save the nation's economy, showcasing a generation of merchants who served their country through commerce.

items.title: Reloved (2025)
items.description: A single dad balancing new fatherhood crosses paths with his long-lost ex, reigniting old feelings and uncovering the truth behind their broken past.

items.title: Treasure at Dawn
items.description: Hua Fusheng is a young man who's innocent and obsessed with medicine. He uses unconventional methods that both endear and frighten the townspeople. He is wrongly accused of murder after the death of Bai Yi. Clues left behind by his mentor seem to point to a mysterious "Sacred Book." At the same time, Wen Jue, the daughter of Liangzhou city lord, and Gu Tian, an inheritor of the performing arts, get drawn into the mystery. The three of them head to Liangzhou to investigate. Wen Jue uses her family's influence to help Hua Fusheng open a clinic, while Gu Tian's quick wit aids them in gathering intel. As Hua Fusheng heals the poor, he hunts for the truth, but strange events unfold, and the puzzle deepens. Unknown to him, his arrival has already stirred hidden forces in Liangzhou...

items.title: Second Chance Romance
items.description: Retired ballet artist Tan Siting returns to China, wanting to seek a second chance with Feng Rui, the lover she was once forced to leave behind. But past misunderstandings have built a wall between them. Feng Rui's orderly life as a a single father is thrown into chaos by her reappearance. Meanwhile, Tan Siting is accompanied by a man who has loved her from afar for a decade. As Tan Siting and Feng Rui try to avoid each other, fate keeps forcing them together, leaving them trapped in a turbulent mix of love and heartache.

items.title: Marry Him in Her Place
items.description: On her wedding night, wealthy heiress Liang Yi is betrayed by her husband, disfigured, and cast into a river. Rescued and given a new face, she assumes the identity of courtesan Xu Yin and draws close to gang leader Lin Yun, determined to take her revenge.

items.title: Thundercloud Rainstorm
items.description: Bound by a debt, an illegitimate son moves in with his aloof cousin, unaware that their uneasy deal will spiral into a deep and dangerous obsession.

items.title: Burnout Syndrome
items.description: After losing his dream job, a burned-out artist falls between two men—a charming IT guy and a reclusive tycoon who hires him to be his public face.

items.title: Love Is Always Online
items.description: Entrepreneur Jiang Anlan secretly joins a virtual game to track down his first love, Yao Yuan, rekindling their relationship and bringing it into the real world. Just as their wedding plans begin, long-standing family grudges and unexpected hardships threaten to break them apart. Facing misunderstandings and illness, they must fight for each other and their future to prove that true love can withstand even the deepest grudges.

items.title: Reversing Time
items.description: When Yu Xingchen learns that his first love Su Ruo has died, he’s suddenly pulled into a time vortex that sends him fifteen years into the past. Now back in high school, he finds Su Ruo alive at eighteen. As he relives their youth, he revisits forgotten moments and uncovers hidden clues about her fate. Caught between the past and present, Yu Xingchen must solve the mystery of her death—before time runs out and he loses her forever.

items.title: Oops! I????????m in Jail
items.description: After a career-ending injury, Taekwondo star Zhiyao falls into gambling and is forced to become a prison administrator, tasked with overseeing the notorious boss Chihuahua under the watchful eye of instructor Jiang Yijie. Amid the harsh, absurd conditions, Zhiyao and his colleagues form bonds of friendship, trust, and love, finding meaning and resilience in their challenging work.

items.title: Heroes Next Door
items.description: It tells the thrilling and humorous story of a reserve special forces unit that comes together not to protect the country or promote world peace but to safeguard their families and neighborhood.

items.title: Me and Thee
items.description: An introverted photographer's life changes when a former mafia boss hires him for love advice, only to end up falling for him instead.

items.title: To My Shore
items.description: After a car accident, a ruthless Thai heir and a reserved company executive become trapped in a dangerous game of desire that spirals into obsession.

items.title: Tide of Love
items.description: A wealthy heir and an art student enter a transactional arrangement that slowly deepens into real affection, forcing them to face what they truly want.

items.title: Interminable
items.description: After inheriting an old house, a student meets a ghost who reveals their tragic past life and the eternal fate that still binds them.

items.title: Therapy Game
items.description: After a one-night stand, a photographer bets he can win over the heartbroken vet student, only to get entangled in the chaotic mess of his own game.

items.title: Last Samurai Standing
items.description: In the early Meiji era, Shujiro, once known as an undefeated samurai, decides to participate in a deadly survival game to save his family and villagers.

items.title: The 4th Love Revolution
items.description: After a university merges its modeling and computer engineering departments, the charming model Min-hak and the perfectionist coder Yeon-san, polar opposites in every way, unexpectedly fall for each other.

items.title: Dynamite Kiss
items.description: A passionate fling in Jeju ends abruptly — until fate reunites an heir and a young woman when she joins his company, disguised as a married mother.

items.title: Blemish Flaw
items.description: Mystery video blogger Yang Zhenghui investigates the long disappearance of his ex-girlfriend Liu Wei, uncovering connections to ceramic artist Zeng Jie and events from a year ago.  As Yang Zhenghui digs deeper, the dark logic behind the truth begins to surface.

items.title: IT: Welcome to Derry
items.description: In 1962, amid a spate of unexplained disappearances of local children, a group of misfit friends begin to suspect a long-buried ancient evil lurking. As the kids set out to determine what's really going on, a rising unease prompts several townspeople to work together to restore peace – all while a U.S. military operation seeks to exploit Derry for its own objectives.

items.title: Moon River
items.description: In Joseon, a vengeful crown prince and a memory-lost merchant mysteriously swap bodies, unraveling a web of chaos, secrets, and unexpected fate.

items.title: As You Stood By
items.description: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.

items.title: Peach Trap
items.description: At the lowest point in both his career and life, Yoo Do-ha unexpectedly encounters three very different men — a cold yet caring former boss, a playful younger barista, and a devoted childhood friend. Caught in a whirlwind of overlapping “peach blossoms,” Do-ha finds himself at the center of three blossoming romances. But who will win his heart in the end?

items.title: Dear X (2025)
items.description: Behind a beautiful face hides a cruel nature—Baek Ah-jin, who sees through and manipulates others' hearts. After stepping on the sacrifices of many to reach the top, everything begins to change the moment she arrives there. A woman wearing a mask to escape hell and climb to the highest place. And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.

items.title: The Manipulated
items.description: Taejoong's life is torn apart when he's framed for a heinous crime and imprisoned. Discovering it was all orchestrated by someone on the outside, he embarks on a rage-fueled quest for revenge.

items.title: Good Day
items.description: A music project program where G-Dragon completes the song of the year with people from various fields.

items.title: Nice to Not Meet You
items.description: A hateful romance between a professional detective actor who wants to become a melodrama master and a female reporter who was demoted from a political reporter who won the Reporter of the Year award to the entertainment department.

items.title: Chef Son-In-Law
items.description: Qiao Zhi forsakes a promising corporate career to revive his grandfather’s lost culinary legacy, reclaim the family restaurant, and restore the glory of traditional Chinese cuisine.

items.title: Chosen Home
items.description: A clumsy romantic, an aloof teacher and a troubled teen cross paths, forming an unlikely household in this offbeat comedy about love and belonging.

items.title: Last Summer
items.description: Idealist Public Prosecutor Selim Kara receives an offer he cannot refuse from the organized crime leader Selçuk Taşkın, whom he sent to prison 8 years ago. Selçuk Taşkın wants to testify in one of Prosecutor Selim's cases and his testimony will destroy the whole criminal organization. However, there is only one condition for this; the personal protection of his son, Akgün Gökalp Taşkın.

items.title: Mission: Love or Lies
items.description:
Achi, a smart female police captain, is assigned to protect Patty, the daughter of a powerful politician recently targeted in an attack. To stay safe, Patty secretly swaps places with her bodyguard Alice in order to keep the mission under wraps.

As Achi works to keep Patty safe, she starts to feel something more than just duty. Love begins to grow—slowly, quietly—in the middle of danger. But strange things begin to happen, and Patty and Alice are both hiding something.

items.title: Goddess Bless You from Death
items.description: A gifted young man and a rational detective investigate brutal forest murders, uncovering ancient beliefs and dangers that defy all logic.

items.title: Eternal Joy with You
items.description: After being betrayed in her past life, Xu Wannian is reborn, determined to protect her biological child and exact revenge on those who wronged her. As she confronts dark secrets and crosses paths with Pei Heng, an investigator linked to her past, they uncover a deep connection that spans lifetimes.

items.title: Zomvivor
items.description: When an apocalyptic virus that turns people into zombies ravages a city, a group of students take shelter in a school and fight to survive.

items.title: Oops! Almost Broke Up
items.description: After breaking up, Chen Jiawen and Shen Meng find themselves trapped in a repeating day. As they face a series of emotional challenges and confront buried issues, they must work together to break the cycle and move forward.

items.title: Fight for Love
items.description: After her father's death in battle and a mysterious warning from her injured brother, Chu Yu vows to uncover the truth. She marries into the defeated Wei family as Wei Jun’s widow to investigate, where she meets the sole survivor, Wei Yun. Though initially guarded, Wei Yun grows fond of Chu Yu, and mutual feelings emerge. Despite the obstacle of their "in-law" relationship, they face dangers together, uncover secrets, and protect their homeland side by side.

items.title: Search for Soul Stone
items.description: Fifty years ago, the sudden emergence of spiritual energy within jadeite gave rise to families of superpowered individuals. After his clan is wiped out for their rare ability to sense jade aura, young Meng Yan escapes with a mysterious girl, Xiao Duo. Years later, he returns with newfound powers to seek revenge, igniting an epic clash between two generations of gifted beings.

items.title: Tales of Five Immortal
items.description: In war-torn Republican-era China, Lai Fu, a wandering sorcerer, sets out to avenge his family's massacre by unraveling a supernatural mystery, only to uncover a far-reaching conspiracy involving spirit possessions, treason, and a powerful enemy from his past.

items.title: Physical: Asia
items.description: Elite athletes from eight countries battle for national pride. After grueling tests of raw strength and endurance, only one flag can claim victory.

items.title: Noon-You Are a Woman to Me
Moonlit Order
items.description: Feng Zuoren, a skilled assassin, disguises herself as a beautiful stepmother to infiltrate a noble family and eliminate the former crown prince. However, her mission becomes complicated when she develops a tense and unexpected bond with her clever stepson, uncovering secrets that challenge everything she thought she knew.

items.title: My Foxfoe Queen
items.description: After the Fox Clan is wiped out by Prince Xiling Xuan of Xiling Kingdom, the clan’s sacred maiden Tu Shanyue survives as a wandering soul and possesses the body of the late Empress Jiang Xin'er. Determined to take revenge, she infiltrates the palace—only to uncover a shocking truth that changes everything.

items.title: The Dream Life of Mr. Kim
items.description: Kim Nak-su is a middle-aged man who loses everything he once considered valuable in an instant. After a long journey, he finally discovers his true self, beyond his role as a department manager at a large corporation.

items.title: My Safe Zone
items.description: Alin leaves her best friend Jane to study abroad. Years later, a broken engagement brings her home, where they face feelings long unspoken.

items.title: Whispers of Fate
items.description: When an influential and fearsome clan is massacred in mysterious circumstances, the clan’s talented disciple Tang Lici finds himself accused of masterminding the crime. Accusers say that Tang Lici is a traitor who murdered his master. A decade later, suspicions about Tang Lici linger, but much darker forces are conspiring to unleash chaos into the realm. Torn by his duality and his apparent inability to distinguish between good and evil, Tang Lici finds himself drawn back into the wider world to help defeat the evil conspiracy – armed only with his wits and his martial arts skills. His path soon crosses with former acquaintances, with some swearing enmity and others allied to his cause. Can he and his companions help defeat the forces of wickedness – or will his dual nature prove his undoing?

items.title: Boots (2025)
items.description: After impulsively joining the U.S. Marine Corps, a bullied teen finds new purpose — and unexpected brotherhood — with his motley team of fellow recruits.

items.title: Mystique in the Mirror
items.description: Alan is trying to find the answers to who he was in the past and who he is now, every time he looks in the mirror, an old man appears. One day he meets Darwin, a young man who seems to be in the room next to Alan’s in the mental health hospital. He’s liked Alan since their first meeting.

items.title: Queen of Darkness
items.description: After a car accident leaves heiress Ye Ying with amnesia, she is mistaken for a housewife named An Ning and forced to live with a family she doesn’t know. Relying on instinct to survive, she grows drawn to inspector Huo Xiao, even as secrets and deception surround them. As her memories return, Ye Ying must choose between the safety of her false life and the dangerous truth waiting to be uncovered.

items.title: My Secret of Seer
items.description: Cursed by bad luck at 25 and a supernatural sense of smell, a young seer must team up with a charismatic ghost show host to survive a year of curses.

items.title: Blood River
items.description: Blood River is the realm's most feared assassin guild, jointly run by the Su, Mu, and Xie clans. They can strike royals in court and crush great sects in the wild. When the patriarch is poisoned on a mission, the three clans vie for the top seat. Su Muyu leads the Spider-Shadow unit and shields the dying leader on the road to a cure. He clashes with elder Su Zhe and old friend Su Changhe, and meets master healer Bai Hehuai. After brutal power struggles, Su Changhe becomes new patriarch and Su Muyu heads the Su clan. They launch the "Other Shore Plan" to drag Blood River out of the shadow and forge a new destiny, free from being anyone's blade.

items.title: School Trip: Joined a Group I????????m Not Close To
items.description: An awkward teen joins a group of popular classmates on a school trip, sparking an unexpected romance with the most popular and charming boy in school.

items.title: Punks Triangle
items.description: A young designer dreams of creating a look for his favorite model and finally gets his chance–unless his class partner screws things up!

items.title: Light Beyond the Reed
items.description: Ye Sibei has always endured her parents' favoritism toward her brother, choosing to avoid conflict. Her husband, Qin Nan, deeply loves her but grows frustrated with her reluctance to stand up for herself and files for divorce. However, after Sibei faces a traumatic experience, Qin Nan returns to support her, encouraging her to seek justice.

items.title: The Love Never Sets
items.description: After surviving trauma and leaving school, Ice returns to confront his past—only to be cast in an intimate film with the boy he never forgave.

items.title: Sweet Secrets
items.description: Top courtesan Lu Huayan returns to Baillemen to avenge her sister, but her mission takes an unexpected turn when she encounters Li Motong, a mysterious man from another world called Wujian. Tasked with killing her to obtain a legendary artifact that can preserve his realm, Li Motong is shocked to realize Lu Huayan's connection to his past.

items.title: The Ascent of Ling Yun
items.description: Lingyun, a cunning palace maid, rises through the imperial ranks to become the emperor’s favored consort, exposing the empress’s hidden corruption. But her ascent comes at a terrible cost, as she becomes ensnared in ruthless palace intrigues and a forbidden love that could destroy her.

items.title: Starlit Bloom
items.description: Gu Liusu, a meticulous jewelry brand founder and her unexpected one-night stand, Lu Xingchen, find themselves working together as boss and secretary. What begins as a comedic misunderstanding between opposites slowly transforms into a heartfelt romance, as professional respect deepens into emotional connection.

items.title: Revenge Boyfriend
items.description: After a painful breakup with her unfaithful coworker boyfriend, Maika teams up with her company’s new CEO, Shun, in a fake relationship to get revenge. With Shun looking to dodge an arranged engagement, their plan works for both—until hidden motives surface, sparking a deeper web of love, lies, and revenge.

items.title: Typhoon Family
items.description: Depicts the struggles of small and medium-sized businesses and their families who face the 1997 IMF crisis head-on.

items.title: Doubt (2024)
items.description: A successful defense lawyer at a boutique firm becomes romantically involved with a client who may or may not be guilty of a brutal crime.

items.title: Fight for You
items.description: Da Hei takes on dark tasks for medical funds, unaware his roommate Xiao Bai is an intelligence operative. Their growing bond tests their paths forward.

items.title: The Cursed Love
items.description: With his fire powers out of control, a billionaire model teams up with a cynical rescue officer on a dangerous quest to cure his curse in a lost city.

items.title: Takumi-kun Series: Drama
items.description: Amid the pressure and prestige of Shido Gakuin High, two students find themselves drawn into a love that defies expectations.

items.title: Dangerous Queen
items.description:
Bonita spends her time supporting her mother who suffers from alcohol and gambling addiction. In addition to this, her neighbour "Kem" pursues her relentlessly even though she only sees him as a friend.

Her life takes a surprising turn when she goes to a bar and meets "Queen", a high-society woman from a prominent family. Queen helps Bonita escape her mother's abuse and they face various challenges before they become each other's favourite.

"In my life, I have only one favourite person."

items.title: The Story of Bihyung
items.description: When a naïve aspiring actor meets a goblin master feared for centuries, their fated bond reignites a love powerful enough to break a thousand-year curse.

items.title: Beyond The Loop
items.description: After being killed in a deadly betrayal, Yu Yingwan is reborn and stays in the City Lord’s manor to uncover the truth—only to discover her husband Mu Yunqing has also returned from death. Together, they must face the hidden mastermind and fight to change their tragic fate.

items.title: My Stand-In
items.description: Joe, a stuntman reincarnated into another's body after an accident, reconnects with Ming, who seeks answers about Joe's mysterious second chance at life.

items.title: The Tower of Whispers
items.description: After her family is destroyed and she’s killed by the tyrant Jun Che, Lu Yingying is reborn before the tragedy begins. Determined to change her fate, she takes control of her destiny. When she encounters Jun Che again—this time as a powerless slave—she buys him for revenge. But as they face enemies together, hatred turns to love, and their lives become irrevocably intertwined in a battle for justice and redemption.

items.title: The Crush (2024)
items.description: High School is over – but not for Matt. He can’t seem to leave behind his eleventh-grade crush on a boy named Davin. Matt finds himself getting closer to Davin after he reappears in his life after being gone for three long years.

items.title: Marvel Zombies
items.description: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.

items.title: The Immortal Ascension
items.description: Han Li, an ordinary, poor boy from a mountain village, joins a small martial arts sect by chance. Despite his mediocre talent, he eventually cultivates himself into an immortal through hard work and careful planning.

items.title: Long Planned Love
items.description: After a betrayal, heiress Jian Cheng enters a contract marriage with her ex-fiancé’s uncle, Zhou Tingyan. As they navigate family tensions and business battles, their fake marriage blossoms into true love, uncovering past secrets and leading to mutual growth and redemption.

items.title: Miss King
items.description: The daughter of a genius shogi player channels the pain of her father's abandonment and her mother's death to become an elite competitor.

items.title: Ms Incognito
items.description: A bodyguard hides in a village as a kindergarten teacher to avoid her boss' enemies – but faces a new challenge in a skeptical strawberry farmer!

items.title: I Kill U (2025)
items.description: Sun Woo comes from a poor family background. She was once a promising Taekwondo athlete, but she now works part-time jobs to support herself. One day, she is is selected to become the stand-in for Ji Yeon due to their similar appearance. Ji Yeon is the granddaughter of Beomhan Construction Company's chairman. She was the driver of a fatal hit-and-run car accident. Sun Woo must play Ji Yeon in front of the public and media. Meanwhile, Sun Woo becomes the target of Ho Joong’s hostility. Ho Joong is Ji Yeon’s stepbrother and he has an inferiority complex over Ji Yeon. He wants to become the successor to Beomhan Construction Company.

items.title: The Journey to Killing You
items.description: Ordered to guard—and secretly kill—his underboss, a vengeful yakuza begins to fall for the very man he swore to destroy.

items.title: Gemini (2025)
items.description: After being betrayed and killed, sect leader Xiao Jinyu is reborn in the body of the blind Princess Consort Lu Zhao. With the help of her supposed twin brother Xiao Ren, she embarks on a ruthless quest for revenge, uncovering forbidden secrets and deadly power struggles along the way.

items.title: No Mercy
items.description: A survival show made of 12 trainees from Starship Entertainment, home of K.will, Sistar and Mad Clown. They compete against each other in order to form a new hip-hop group.

items.title: First Lady
items.description: After assuming the role of first lady of the Philippines, Melody must rise to her new responsibilities while learning to stay true to herself.

items.title: The Home for Lovers
items.description: Rakumoto Ai, a romance novelist, meets Muto Kaishin, a free-spirited islander, during his stay. Their unexpected encounter stirs something in Ai he can’t quite ignore.

items.title: Billionaires Bunker
items.description: When a group of billionaires takes shelter in a luxury bunker, an old feud between two families resurfaces amid an unprecedented global conflict.

items.title: Twin Fates
items.description: Chi Yu, a cold-hearted phoenix divine beast, unexpectedly forms a twin soul pact with Mu Lingxue, a mortal girl whose family was destroyed by treachery. Bound together on a fateful full moon night, the two grow through shared hardships, forging trust and strength as they face powerful enemies.

items.title: Ghosting
items.description: Stepping off script horror actors turned amateur ghostbusters, Luke Hutchie and Matthew Finlan, bring celebrity guests on paranormal adventures to see if haunted places are truly haunted.

items.title: Walking on Thin Ice
items.description: Eun-soo is a housewife, who struggles to pay for her husband's medical expenses. He is terminally ill. Eun-soo becomes entangled in a bag of drugs with a teacher named Yi-kyeong. He is a mysterious figure. Eun-soo and Yi-kyeong are chased by veteran detective Tae-gu.

items.title: That Summer
items.description: Sent to a remote island for discipline, a troublemaker meets an amnesiac castaway whose presence turns his dull summer into love.

items.title: To the Moon
items.description: Three colleagues at a confectionery company struggle to break free from financial hardship. When they turn to cryptocurrency as a possible solution, their lives are shaken by risk, reward, and unexpected change. Alongside a successful but unfulfilled big data director, they face risk, ambition, and the search for meaning in an uncertain world.

items.title: Sinful Marriage
items.description: After taking the blame for her lover’s crime, Shen Yuanzhi is forced to marry Fan Xingxu, who seeks revenge. But as they uncover a treasonous plot, the two form an unlikely alliance and slowly overcome their misunderstandings.

items.title: Echoes of the Self
items.description: Ambitious Zhou Ruoxi sacrifices love for power, but palace intrigue leads to her and Li Yan’s death. When time miraculously resets, she must right her past mistakes and protect Li Yan - facing her greatest rival: her former self.

items.title: My Secret Vampire
items.description: A naïve student rents a cheap mansion in Seoul, only to learn his generous roommates are vampires—and his blood is the price of admission.

items.title: Mobius (2025)
items.description: In Hua'ao City, a brilliant detective with a flawless track record faces his toughest case yet when a string of seemingly perfect murders shakes the city. With no evidence, no witnesses, and a killer who vanishes without a trace, he must race against time to uncover the truth. As hidden dangers lurk in every corner, the line between hunter and hunted begins to blur.

items.title: MuTeLuv
items.description: This anthology tells seven stories of people who attempt to use supernatural forces to meet their goals, and their unique journeys to finding love along the way.

items.title: The Sun in the Dark
items.description: Branded a demon since birth, Bai Xiaoying seeks immortality to avenge her father. Bound to the Night God Ye Chenyuan, she uncovers a celestial plot and, through sacrifice and love, fights to restore peace to the heavens.

items.title: The Girlfriend
items.description: Laura has it all: a glittering career, a loving husband, and her precious son, Daniel. But her perfect life unravels when Daniel brings home Cherry, a girlfriend who changes everything. After a tense introduction, Laura becomes convinced Cherry is hiding something. Is she a manipulative social climber, or is Laura just paranoid? The truth is a matter of perspective.

items.title: Learning to Love
items.description: This romance follows two unlikely souls bridging vast differences through secret lessons. A strict high school teacher, raised in a rigid household, begins tutoring a kind-hearted but illiterate nightclub host. As their bond deepens, societal judgment, jealousy, and prejudice threaten their forbidden connection.

items.title: A Hundred Memories
items.description: A heartbreaking first love story of a man who was destined to be the fate of two women who were bus guides in the 1980s, and a melodrama-comedy of shining youths who were destined to be brilliant.

items.title: You and Everything Else
items.description: From teen years to adulthood, two friends linked by warmth and tension grow apart — until one is asked to accompany the other through her final days.

items.title: Chihayafuru: Full Circle
items.description: Sophomore Meguru just wants to focus on her future. But when forced to participate in her high school's competitive karuta club, she finds a new passion.

items.title: Go up against the Immortal
items.description: After betrayal leaves him for dead, Chen Yuan gains extraordinary powers and, with three formidable allies, embarks on a vengeful quest to defy fate, crush powerful clans, and protect the world from destruction.

items.title: The Dark Dice
items.description: When a mysterious dice game puts lives on the line, players must fight, betray, and survive—or lose everything.

items.title: A Fleeting Dream
items.description: After a devastating betrayal that costs her everything and nearly her life, Lian Xinru, a wealthy merchant’s daughter, returns years later disguised as a famous singer. Partnering with Pei Yuze, the enigmatic man who saved her, she embarks on a calculated and thrilling quest for justice and revenge.

items.title: Confidence Queen
items.description: Three con artists with different backgrounds, team up for a daring and adventurous scheme of revenge against the villains of this era.

items.title: My Youth
items.description: The story of Sun Woo-hae and Sung Je-yun, who reunite after 15 years, struggling and living fiercely in their respective stages.

items.title: Blend Feelings
items.description: After being betrayed in both love and career by her boyfriend, a traditional incense maker named Jian Xiangxiang discovers mysterious on-screen messages that predict her grim future. Determined to change her fate and seek revenge, she sets out to seduce Gu Jingshi - her ex’s powerful, wheelchair-bound uncle. What starts as a calculated plan for vengeance turns into an unexpected entanglement of passion and power.

items.title: I Love You Since 1892
items.description: Transported to the Spanish colonial era, a young woman finds love, uncovers secrets, and faces a destiny beyond time.

items.title: Hierarchy
items.description: The top 0.01% of students control law and order at Jooshin High School, but a secretive transfer student chips a crack in their indomitable world.

items.title: Restarted Love
items.description: Lu Ming and Xu Xin’s marriage weakens over time due to daily conflicts. After Xu Xin falls into a coma from a car accident, Lu Ming discovers her novel about an idealized husband, forcing him to confront his shortcomings and regret his past mistakes.

items.title: Twelve Letters
items.description: In a small town, twelve mysterious letters and a 35-year wait intertwine to shape the lives and loves of a close-knit group of friends. Yu Nian and Shen Cheng’s world is thrown into turmoil when their parents vanish, followed by cryptic messages arriving from another time. Driven to uncover the truth, they plunge into a complex puzzle, navigating dual timelines and unraveling the secrets hidden within the letters that could explain their disappearance.

items.title: First Love (2025)
items.description: Young, free and madly in love. As teenagers, the world was their oyster—but, as adults, their lives seem dimmer, like a very important piece is missing.

items.title: Lock Her (2025)
items.description: After surviving a brutal massacre, Qin Shiyue is taken in by Commander Dai Shiyao and finds herself caught between two brothers: A Sheng, whose feelings evolve from greed to love, and Dai Shiyao, who moves from suspicion to affection. As war erupts, they challenge their destinies through sacrifice and loyalty, while Qin Shiyue uncovers the truth behind her father’s wrongful death and discovers a new beginning.

items.title: My Bias is Showing
items.description: A flustered teacher scrambles to hide his fanboy side when his idol films at school—but being cast as his co-mentor makes secrets hard to keep.

items.title: The Demon (2025)
items.description: Fan Dayao, the mighty Tiger Demon King, rules Qianchun Mountain with absolute power. Shen Wangchen, a frail and distant nobleman’s son, seeks a cat demon to cure his illness. When they meet, an unlikely and humorous cohabitation between human and demon begins.

items.title: Butterfly (2025)
items.description: David Jung, a mysterious former US intelligence operative living in hiding in South Korea, has his life blown to pieces when the consequences of an impossible decision from his past come back to haunt him, and he finds himself hunted by Rebecca, a deadly young assassin, and Caddis, the sinister spy organization she works for.

items.title: Kill to Love (2025)
items.description: A Southern prince and a Northern assassin, bound since childhood, struggle with love and betrayal as political intrigue threatens to tear them apart.

items.title: The Seven Relics of ill Omen
items.description: Adapted from the novel The Seven Relics of ill Omen by Weiyu. In ancient times, a mysterious substance descended upon Fengzi Ridge. Capable of parasitic invasion, it twists the human heart and lures its host into evil. Now, these relics of ill omen have reemerged, unleashing a series of bizarre and gruesome murders. Five ordinary yet passionate young people—Mu Dai, Luo Ren, Thirteen-Thousand, Yan Hongsha, and Cao Yanhua—are successively drawn into this crisis through their own fateful encounters. They form the "Phoenix Squad" and embark on a perilous quest to subdue these ill omens. Amid life-and-death trials, Luo Ren and Mu Dai heal each other's wounds and forge a genuine bond. Through a long and arduous journey fraught with danger, the five overcome relentless challenges, their friendship tempered and deepened in the fires of adversity.

items.title: Shadow Love (2025)
items.description: General Li Shuang of Taijin finds a man who has lost his memory and names him Jin'an. Jin'an devotes himself to accompanying Li Shuang; however, as he gradually regains his memories, he discovers that he is actually a prince from an enemy nation. Once bound by love, the two are forced into battle. Together, they confront challenges that test their loyalties and beliefs, striving to resolve the conflict and uphold the justice they both believe in.

items.title: Twelve (2025)
items.description: A group of heroes, each embodying one of the 12 zodiac signs, battles to defend the Korean Peninsula from malevolent spirits.

items.title: Aema (2025)
items.description: In 1980s Korea, a movie star and a starlet defy male-dominated industry rules and backstage corruption while filming the provocative "Madame Aema."

items.title: Our Golden Days
items.description: An interior designer has a one-sided crush on her former college senior – but his best friend is secretly in love with her.

items.title: Princess Revenge
items.description: After being betrayed by the man she gave everything up for, Dongfang Xi, a wealthy heiress, discovers she's the villainess in a novel and makes a deal with a mysterious system to change her fate—only to find that the system itself hides a long-buried secret of love.

items.title: Love on the Edge of Divorce
Serial Homicide
items.description: The peaceful city of Luzhou is shaken by a series of so-called justice-driven murders. To crack the case, authorities form the 909 Task Force, which works tirelessly to unravel the layers of the chilling exchange-killing revenge scheme.

items.title: Moonlit Reunion
items.description: Mei Zhuyu, a calm and reserved nobleman from a lesser branch of the Mei family, arrives in Chang'an as an official at the Bureau of Mystic Investigations. During a banquet, he meets Wu Zhen, the bold and unruly younger sister of the Empress and secret Guardian of the Demon Underworld. Both hide their true identities. Wu, a half-demon striving to keep peace, and Mei, a skilled demon slayer, seek the truth behind the fire 18 years ago. As bone demons rise and unrest grows, they fight side by side, forming a bond that deepens into love until the Changxi Palace launches a purge, forcing them to face each other's secrets and the past they share.

items.title: A Forbidden Marriage
items.description: Yang Wangyue, the reborn saint of the Holy Fire Sect, is given a second chance at life and pursues her long-held wish to be with Yang Qing, an elder of a righteous sect. Together, they attempt to uncover the true mastermind behind the chaos and strive to reconcile the warring sects, to bring peace to the martial world.

items.title: Her Feast
items.description: After being framed and tortured to death, Zhang Wange is reborn three years in the past with memories of her previous life. Determined to uncover the truth, she teams up with police captain Lu Ye, whose dreams begin revealing key clues. As they follow these leads, their fates become deeply intertwined.

items.title: Long For Fish
items.description: Modern-day office drone Zou Yan accidentally stumbles into the world of cultivation and wakes up as Liao Tingyan, a disciple of the Qinggutian Sect. She's soon selected to serve the reclusive Grandmaster Sima Jiao, a powerful cultivator who's been secretly sealed inside a mountain for 500 years. Twisted by isolation and rage, he's cold, hot-tempered, and bent on revenge. Liao Tingyan doesn't know that "her" original identity is a demonic assassin. But to his surprise, she shows no ill will, no ambition, and no desire at all. Her nature fascinates him. Thus begins an unlikely romance between a villainous immortal and a healing-type "slacker," a connection that defies fate and spans lifetimes.

items.title: This Thriving Land
items.description: On her wedding day, Ning Xiuxiu, the daughter of Tianqiang Temple Village's richest man, is kidnapped by bandits. Her father refuses to pay the ransom, marrying her sister to her childhood sweetheart instead. In defiance, Xiuxiu cuts ties with her family and marries farmer Feng Dajiao, learning the value of land and community. Inspired by revolutionary ideals, she empowers village women to challenge feudal beliefs and leads efforts against banditry and the Japanese invasion.

items.title: Threads of Destiny (2025)
items.description: After being reborn, Jiang Xueying swaps marriages with her sister and becomes the Crown Princess. She must outwit rival women in the household and join forces with her seemingly idle husband to expose a dangerous conspiracy.

items.title: Taste (2025)
items.description: What is Olivia Rodrigo's new album really about, and why is purple her signature color? Why do some artists choose to go through life masked? And did you know that two members of BTS are returning after two years of military service, but isn't Stray Kids simply *the* K-pop act of today? And as a fan, how do you know what fan activities are expected of you at a Taylor Swift concert?

items.title: Queendom (2025)
items.description: A musical battle between 6 trending girl group acts, in order to "determine the real number one" when all 6 release their songs at the same time.

items.title: Rearrange (2025)
items.description: Win gets a second chance to relive the past and chase the dreams he once shared with Nut. But as he tries to change fate, will he save their love—or lose it again?

items.title: Enigma Black Stage (2025)
items.description: When the play “The Bloom and a Thousand Bees” is in being remade, it calls for a serious casting for the lead female role. Now, everyone in showbiz scrambles for and it seems they will do whatever it takes. Thus, the watchful eye of a certain group looms over this audition. What no one knows is that there’s a dangerous secret lurking behind the curtain, and whatever black magic is called upon.

items.title: Shine (2025)
items.description: In 1969 Bangkok, idealistic economist Trin meets carefree musician Tanwa amid political unrest, sparking a forbidden romance that tests their beliefs.

items.title: The Formless City
items.description: After getting caught up in a brutal case, young forensic assistant Xu Linlang joins forces with the bold Lu Jiu and clever Sima Kong. Together, the trio navigates the treacherous underworld of Wuxiang City, solving mysteries and uncovering hidden truths, all while forging deep bonds and growing through danger and discovery.

items.title: In the Name of Dawn
items.description: On her wedding night, Gu Chaochao is betrayed by her husband and best friend and left for dead. Five years later, she returns as Ji Yunchao, plotting a calculated revenge to expose their deceit and take back control of her destiny.

items.title: Fell Upon Me
items.description: In 2012, high schooler An Zhenzhen's phone mysteriously connects to a future version of her classmate Jiang Ling from 2024. Guided by his messages, she attempts to alter the course of fate, but her actions trigger a series of misunderstandings and tragedies that intertwine their lives across time.

items.title: Flower Sea (2025)
items.description: After a mysterious soul swap, Chen Jing'an and Zhu Niannian wake up in each other's bodies - one becoming a wealthy heiress, the other the sister of her secret crush. As they search for the cause with the help of Chen Changning, unexpected complications arise, and the truth leads them down a path they never anticipated.

items.title: She Is the Phoenix
items.description: After being betrayed and killed by her best friend and powerful elites, Jiang Leyao is reborn with memories of her tragic past. Determined to take revenge, she discovers her friend has also been reborn and taken her place in a wealthy marriage. As Jiang Leyao begins her counterattack, she realizes her enemy is backed by an even greater force, complicating her path to justice.

items.title: Be Not Meant to Be
items.description: Ye Nanzhao is betrayed by her ex-husband and loses her daughter. Kidnapped while seeking justice, she's forced to assume a dead woman’s identity and becomes a concubine in a wealthy household, only to discover her ex-husband is now the family’s new son-in-law. Trapped in a web of lies and buried secrets, she must fight to reclaim her life.

items.title: Love Take Two
items.description: A single mom and her medical student daughter have entered an unexpected second act in their lives. A story of love that is not an end but a beginning that comes to them as they decide to live happily today instead of tomorrow.

items.title: Duel on Mount Hua
items.description: «Jin Yong Wuxia Universe» (金庸武侠世界 / The Legend of Heroes) is a martial arts series based on the novels of Jin Yong, with «The Legend of the Condor Heroes» as its main plotline. The series weaves together two dramatic stories – «Hot Blooded» (30 episodes) and «Duel on Mount Hua» (30 episodes), the latter encompassing four character arcs: «Nine Yin True Sutra» (8 episodes), «Eastern Heretic and Western Venom» (8 episodes), «Southern Emperor and Northern Beggar» (8 episodes), and «Five Great Masters» (6 episodes).

items.title: My Lovely Journey
items.description: An unsuccessful idol pivots to working as a travel reporter, finding true happiness for herself and building connections with others.

items.title: Bastard Wargod
items.description: A once-comatose divine general, Chu Beichi, hides his true identity and returns as a low-born son in his household. As he rises through the ranks with his wisdom and strength, he uncovers political conspiracies and quells rebellions across nations to unite the world under his command.

items.title: Memoir of Rati
items.description: In 1915, Rati returns to Siam and finds connection with Thee, the heir to a wealthy and powerful family, which seeks to sabotage the relationship.

items.title: Mary Kills People
items.description: Dr. Mary Harris, a single mother and emergency doctor by day, also moonlights as an underground angel of death - helping terminally ill patients who want to die and slip away on their own terms. So far Mary has managed to stay under the radar; but business is booming, and her double life is getting complicated. When her world starts to unravel, Mary realizes she's going to have to fight dirty if she's going to stay in the killing game.

items.title: Stay by My Side after the Rain
items.description: Shinichiro’s quiet life shifts when he reunites with Kosuke, the classmate he once loved in secret. Is this his second chance at something real?

items.title: The Witch (2025)
items.description: The story of a woman who is kicked out of her village and called a "witch" when the men that she likes get hurt or die, and a man who risks his life to try to save her from the law of death.

items.title: Glass Heart
items.description: An aspiring drummer suddenly loses her spot in the band. But when a brilliant musician recruits her for his new band, her life takes a passionate turn.

items.title: Stealing Heart
items.description: In Republican-era China, orphan Lin Chuning believes her best friend Xiaorou was killed by the wealthy playboy Lu Siyan. Bent on revenge, she infiltrates the Lu family by impersonating his long-lost "twin sister," posing as the missing heiress to get close to him and exact vengeance.

items.title: Better Halves
items.description: Better Halves is a TVB costume television series, premiered in 2003. Theme song "Beautiful Fate" composition and arrangement by Joseph Koo, lyricist by Wong Jim, sung by Steven Ma.

items.title: Nine Yin True Sutra
items.description: «Jin Yong Wuxia Universe» (金庸武侠世界 / The Legend of Heroes) is a martial arts series based on the novels of Jin Yong, with «The Legend of the Condor Heroes» as its main plotline. The series weaves together two dramatic stories – «Hot Blooded» (30 episodes) and «Duel on Mount Hua» (30 episodes), the latter encompassing four character arcs: «Nine Yin True Sutra» (8 episodes), «Eastern Heretic and Western Venom» (8 episodes), «Southern Emperor and Northern Beggar» (8 episodes), and «Five Great Masters» (6 episodes).

items.title: DogBro (2025)
items.description: When a dog-loving loner is forced to share his home with a clingy new roommate, he never expects the real puppy to steal his heart will be human.

items.title: My Magic Prophecy
items.description: A skeptical doctor and a fortune teller must hide from a shadowy threat in a remote village, where danger and romance intertwine.

items.title: Harmony Secret
items.description: Two business heiresses—Aiwarin and Maevika—from a hotel empire and from a department store dynasty, respectively, compete for a national Duty-Free bid. From the moment they meet, an undeniable attraction sparks.

items.title: The Winning Try
items.description: A disgraced former rugby star returns as a coach to his high school’s struggling team, where he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and helps the determined captain lead the team to redemption.

items.title: Trigger (2025)
items.description: As illegal firearms flood into a gun-free South Korea, a resolute cop and a mysterious partner join forces to stop the chaos from sweeping the nation.

items.title: Suntiny
items.description: After a growing rift, Sun and Nuea wake up in each other’s bodies. What begins as a curse becomes a chance to understand—and possibly reconnect.

items.title: Secret Lover (2025)
items.description: During a campus play, a 'relationship training' game turns real as lifelong friends cross boundaries and slip into a secret romance.

items.title: Hide & Sis
items.description: When Chatfah, the youngest daughter of the wealthy Buppajinda family, mysteriously falls from a vacation home and vanishes just before her wedding, her three older sisters become the prime suspects. As suspicion and tragedy mount, the sisters return to their childhood mansion to uncover the truth behind Chatfah’s disappearance—even if it means confronting the possibility that one of them is responsible.

items.title: Deep Affection Eyes
items.description: Ye Meng, seeking a fresh start after career setbacks, returns to her hometown for a quieter life. There, she meets the mysterious Li Jinyu, whose reserved nature and deeply expressive eyes intrigue her. As their connection deepens, they embark on a journey of mutual healing and unexpected love.

items.title: Love Lurking
items.description: Surgeon Gu Nian saves a drug dealer and is pulled into a deadly underworld, where they fall in love. After he vanishes in an explosion, she later meets a man who looks just like him but claims to be someone else. As she searches for the truth behind her mother’s death, hidden identities and buried secrets slowly unravel.

items.title: Our Movie
items.description: A director with no future and an actress with no tomorrow fall into a love story that cannot wait.

items.title: The Nice Guy
items.description: Seok-cheol, the eldest son in a family of three generations of gangsters, navigates the tumultuous ups and downs of life with tears and laughter, all to protect his family, career, and love.

items.title: Knock Out
items.description: After losing everything, Keen finds refuge in a Muay Thai gym and forms a bond with Than, a silent fighter carrying deep scars.

items.title: Returned Master
items.description: After his family is massacred, Li Jianwei hides as a courtesan to seek revenge while drawing dangerously close to his unsuspecting target.

items.title: Avenues of the Diamond
items.description: Sam is a friendly communications student who likes to party. Clyden is a snobby med student focused on studying. One day, these opposites suddenly find themselves arranged to be married. Will they escape their engagement or will this forced arrangement turn into real love?

items.title: Seducing Drake Palma
items.description: With over 125 million reads on Wattpad, this hit story follows Alys, a bubbly girl who agrees to seduce the mysterious Drake Palma to help her best friend. But as their pretend relationship starts to feel real, Alys is torn between loyalty and unexpected love.

items.title: The First Night with the Duke
items.description: Reincarnated as a minor character in a novel, Cha Seon-taek unexpectedly spends a night with Prince Kyungsung, sparking an intense and unexpected romance.

items.title: Heavenly Secrets Bureau
items.description: The son of a fallen official teams up with a talented princess to investigate strange occurrences linked to witchcraft and celestial phenomena. As they delve deeper, they uncover a prophecy from an ancient celestial text that warns of a looming disaster threatening the realm.

items.title: Low Life
items.description: A dangerous story of rough people obsessed with shameless greed who gather together with their own greed and logic to find underwater artifacts off the coast of Shinan.

items.title: Better Late Than Single
items.description: Ready to step into the dating world, lifelong singles get expert help for style, health and confidence. Will they manage hiccups on their way to love?

items.title: Wild Fire
items.description: In a turbulent era, a rich young master falls for a lowly opera performer. Despite harsh social divides, rumors, and betrayal, they bravely fight for a passionate love, determined to be together against all odds.

items.title: S Line
items.description: A young woman with the ability to see mysterious red connections between lovers discovers her secret gift is no longer unique when special glasses granting similar powers appear on the black market.

items.title: Who Rules The World
items.description: A legendary wuxia romance that focuses on the decade-long romance between Hei Fengxi and Bai Fengxi, and the adventures they embark on together.

items.title: Royal Upstart
items.description: After a mysterious accident, Xiao Ning finds himself transported into another world as the live-in son-in-law of the powerful Su family. Using ancient techniques to revolutionize tea and wine, he uses his sharp wit and strategies to quickly rise to prominence.

items.title: Waiting for You
items.description: In the Netherworld, a carefree soul named Tong Feng is unexpectedly ordered to finish her cultivation within three months and reincarnate. Her journey across ancient, republican, and modern eras not only tests her fate but also reveals a long-buried connection with the realm’s ruler, Xuan Pei.

items.title: Destiny Switch
items.description: After timecaster Luo Jie accidentally transmigrates into the body of a tycoon’s illegitimate son, he gains the power to manipulate time. While investigating the original owner's death, he becomes entangled in gang conflicts and uncovers a deeper conspiracy tied to a mysterious force and a looming future disaster.

items.title: A Dream Like the True Love
items.description: After escaping a forced fate at a brothel, Chen Pan’er takes on a new identity and crosses paths with Wen Su, a nobleman who once saved her but is now bound to a powerful princess. Together, they navigate injustice and political intrigue, determined to clear their names and reclaim their freedom.

items.title: Ten Years of Unrequited Love
items.description: A decade after parting ways over class differences, Lin Miaomiao and CEO Cen Siyuan reunite during a business crisis. As past feelings and long-hidden truths resurface, they must decide if love deserves a second chance.

items.title: Falling for Divinity
items.description: A gifted girl protected by a mountain deity falls in love with an amnesiac general she once saved. Bound by a vow that drives them apart, she later reunites with him, only to be met with cold suspicion. Disguised as a soldier, she joins his army and uses her prophetic abilities to protect him. But when her people face annihilation, Bu Nian’s true identity awakens, forcing her to choose between the man she loves and the destiny she was born to fulfill.

items.title: Falling for Divinity
items.description: A gifted girl protected by a mountain deity falls in love with an amnesiac general she once saved. Bound by a vow that drives them apart, she later reunites with him, only to be met with cold suspicion. Disguised as a soldier, she joins his army and uses her prophetic abilities to protect him. But when her people face annihilation, Bu Nian’s true identity awakens, forcing her to choose between the man she loves and the destiny she was born to fulfill.

items.title: The Perfect Suspect
items.description: A perfect crime unravels hidden human darkness as a child-related case emerges, exposing the unsettling truths of society beneath its calm facade.

items.title: To Get Master
items.description: After being unexpectedly pulled into the world of a fantasy novel, Li Song'er, a sheltered princess from the Kingdom of Zuimeng, finds herself entangled with a notorious dark lord. With her only way home tied to him, the two are forced into a reluctant partnership, one that quickly turns into a passionate and turbulent love-hate journey.

items.title: Reborn
items.description: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

items.title: I Am a Running Mate
items.description: The story of model student Se-hoon, who goes to the student council elections as a running mate to renew his image, and gradually becomes the core of the election.

items.title: Created in China
items.description: In the late 1990s, Liu Jun returned to Donghai after studying in Germany. He aimed to transform his father's old machinery factory into a modern, technologically advanced facility. Despite facing challenges in technology, funding, and connections, Liu Jun, with the support of local industry leaders, successfully upgraded the factory and established it as a prominent player in China's manufacturing sector.

items.title: Love Blossoms with the Wind
items.description: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Song Qiyue returns to Wuxi to reclaim their guesthouse and start over. With the unexpected help of Gu Cian, a mysterious businessman, she renovates the inn and rediscovers purpose and love. But when she learns Gu Cian is the executive behind a redevelopment project threatening the guesthouse, their growing bond is put to the test.

items.title: Bloom Once More
items.description: In the eighth year of the Tianyuan era, Yue Qianxue is betrayed and killed in battle, followed by Hua Qingming’s failure to protect the capital, leading to widespread chaos. To change this tragic fate, Zhuge Renfeng sacrifices his lifespan to send them back two years in time. Reborn in the sixth year of Tianyuan, Yue Qianxue and Hua Qingming must join forces to rewrite destiny and save their world from destruction.

items.title: Salon De Holmes
items.description: Four overlooked housewives, weighed down by daily chores and ignored by those around them, find renewed purpose by solving everyday cases—reclaiming their voices and reigniting long-forgotten dreams.

items.title: Nana bnb with Seventeen
items.description: As SEVENTEEN is getting ready to celebrate their 10th anniversary, SEVENTEEN will be making some unforgettable memories with HOST NA!

items.title: Fancy Land
items.description: In a quiet coastal town, two mysterious murders disrupt the peaceful lives of single mother Li Xiulan and her daughter Li Yan, as an unexpected police investigation draws them into a chilling web of secrets.

items.title: The Fallen Lady Returns
items.description: After being brutally killed in her past life, Lady Zhang Xiyin is reborn and vows revenge on her husband, Marquis Zhou Yihong, and his concubine. She forms a strategic alliance with Prince Duan Jianli, but as they pursue their goals, an unexpected romance begins to bloom between them.

items.title: Hunter With a Scalpel
items.description: A prominent female forensic investigator suffers from antisocial personality disorder and the process in which the shadow of the father she killed threatens her honor and life.

items.title: Loving the Lie
items.description: Talented painter Xin Yi returns to her hometown to uncover the truth behind a family tragedy. Posing as a rising artist, she targets a powerful collector linked to her past. When his son offers a secret alliance to gain power, the two enter a dangerous game of deception, unleashing turmoil in a seemingly quiet town.

items.title: 9 Years of You
items.description: Two longtime friends navigate their relationship to each other over the course of nine years as their feelings change and grow.

items.title: Paramount (2025)
items.description: After losing her family and being cast aside by her wealthy husband, Bai Luo returns as a cabaret singer with a secret agenda. Behind the glamour, she plots a calculated revenge, determined to make everyone who betrayed her fall under her control.

items.title: Mercy for None
items.description: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death — embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

items.title: Double Happiness
items.description: In the 1980s, Liu Guiping, a kind-hearted farmer, sacrifices his education to help his brother, Liu Quangui, and his love interest, Hao Yiduo, move to the city. Despite facing challenges, Guiping continues to support them while striving to find his own success and love.

items.title: Be Yourself (2025)
items.description: Four women from varying walks of life meet as journalism majors and develop a lasting friendship that guides them through the journey of growing up.

items.title: The Antidote to Love
items.description: In a time of war, poisoned Prince Zhao He is saved by Yi Jiu, a mysterious healer secretly tied to the fallen Moon Clan. As they uncover the truth behind the clan’s massacre, Zhao He and his ally Yun Yao fight to expose the conspiracy and restore peace to the realm.

items.title: Ball Boy Tactics
items.description: A quiet ex-gymnast and a playful basketball star fall into a slow-burning romance where every glance and touch speaks louder than words.

items.title: World of Street Woman Fighter (2025)
items.description: A global dance challenge that showcases the pride of strong women around the world.

items.title: To Get Her
items.description: A famous idol gets trapped inside a video game and his girlfriend finds ways to bring him back. He becomes the 3rd prince who only cares about music and she becomes the 3rd princess with a mission to help him take the throne.

items.title: Oh My Ghost Clients
items.description: No Mu-jin is a labor attorney who happens to see ghosts. After coming back from the brink of death, he begins solving labor problems requested by ghosts.

items.title: What a Wonderful World
items.description: In a city that never slows down, two lonely strangers cross paths and begin to heal from life’s quiet wounds. As they open up to love and shed their emotional armor, they navigate a blurred line between reality and illusion, discovering that the journey to self-acceptance may just begin with someone else.

items.title: Be Passionately in Love
